MPE-ECO-024.sentence: If the Bus Node's newest Bus Registry membership root is older than P-ECO-5, then the Bus Node shall return `Ignore`, never `Reject`, for MPE Envelopes it cannot validate against a known root.
MPE-ECO-024.verify: test: freeze the mocked Ledger Adapter for P-ECO-5 + 60 s; no peer's P₄ counter increases.

MPE-ECO-025.title: Continuity when Bus Registry calls are paused
MPE-ECO-025.sentence: While Midnight rejects `send_mn_transaction` calls, the Bus Node shall continue to accept MPE Envelopes whose membership roots remain inside P-ECO-5.
MPE-ECO-025.verify: test with a mocked Ledger Adapter that rejects submissions: existing members still publish until their roots age out.

MPE-ECO-026.title: One membership tree per period
MPE-ECO-026.sentence: The Bus Registry shall hold the memberships of each membership period of P-ECO-4 in a separate membership tree.
MPE-ECO-026.verify: test on a devnet: after the period ends, a proof against the next period's root fails for a member registered only in the ended period.

MPE-ECO-027.title: Root times from block timestamps
MPE-ECO-027.sentence: The Ledger Adapter shall derive each membership root's publication and supersession times from the timestamps of the finalized blocks that include the root-changing transactions.
MPE-ECO-027.verify: test on a devnet after 3 root updates: each root maps to the timestamp of its including block; inspection: the Bus Registry stores no publication time, because a circuit can compare block time but not read it.

MPE-ECO-028.title: Revocation on evidence
MPE-ECO-028.sentence: When the Bus Registry receives two shares under one admission window, class and credit index that lie on one member's line with distinct MPE Envelope Identifiers, together with that member's Merkle path, the Bus Registry shall mark the membership revoked.
MPE-ECO-028.verify: test: submit the two shares of a double use; the member's leaf is reset and its identity commitment enters the revoked set; inspection: the leaf index and the identity commitment become public.

MPE-ECO-029.title: Revocation takes effect
MPE-ECO-029.sentence: When a membership is revoked, the Bus Registry shall exclude it from every membership root published after the revocation.
MPE-ECO-029.verify: test: after revocation plus P-ECO-5, an Envelope from the revoked member gets `Ignore` at every Bus Node.

MPE-ECO-030.title: No per-Envelope ledger state
MPE-ECO-030.sentence: The Bus Registry shall not write any per-Envelope admission nullifier or per-Envelope identifier into ledger state.
MPE-ECO-030.verify: inspection of the Bus Registry contract's state declarations.

MPE-ECO-031.title: Equivocation evidence retention
MPE-ECO-031.sentence: The Bus Node shall retain each recorded equivocation evidence pair for at least P-ECO-14.
MPE-ECO-031.verify: test: evidence remains retrievable through the Bus Node interface after P-ECO-14 − 1 s.

MPE-ECO-032.title: Bond custody
MPE-ECO-032.sentence: Where membership bonds are enabled, the Bus Registry shall hold each bond in NIGHT until P-ECO-14 after its holder requests withdrawal.
MPE-ECO-032.verify: Quint model invariant "no withdrawal before the delay"; devnet test of a withdrawal at delay − 1 block (fails) and + 1 block (succeeds).
MPE-ECO-032.note: Bonds in MPE-ECO-032 to MPE-ECO-042 are balances of the Bus Registry contract. They have no relation to NIGHT staking, which locks nothing and "carries no consensus weight".

MPE-ECO-033.title: Slash split
MPE-ECO-033.sentence: Where membership bonds are enabled, when the Bus Registry accepts slash evidence for a bonded membership, the Bus Registry shall pay at most P-ECO-15 of the bond to the reporter.
MPE-ECO-033.verify: test: an equivocator self-reports and recovers ≤ P-ECO-15 of the bond.

MPE-ECO-034.title: Bus Registry funds invariant
MPE-ECO-034.sentence: Where membership bonds or a treasury are enabled, the Bus Registry shall hold NIGHT equal to outstanding bonds plus the treasury balance plus challenge escrow.
MPE-ECO-034.verify: Quint model check over bond, slash, withdraw, challenge and payout actions; balance comparison on devnet after each action.

MPE-ECO-035.title: Maintainer cannot move bonds
MPE-ECO-035.sentence: The Bus Registry shall move bonded NIGHT only through its coded slash, withdraw and payout circuits.
MPE-ECO-035.verify: inspection of every Bus Registry circuit that calls `sendUnshielded`; a test that a maintenance-authority call cannot transfer funds.

MPE-ECO-036.title: Registration publicity disclosed
MPE-ECO-036.sentence: Where a membership requires an unshielded NIGHT deposit, the MPE client library shall tell the user, before submission, that the funding address becomes publicly linked to a membership registration.
MPE-ECO-036.verify: demonstration: the registration flow shows the notice and requires confirmation.

MPE-ECO-037.title: No protocol pay for relaying
MPE-ECO-037.sentence: The Bus Registry shall not pay any Bus Operator for forwarding MPE Envelopes.
MPE-ECO-037.verify: inspection of Bus Registry payout circuits.

MPE-ECO-038.title: No performance-score payouts
MPE-ECO-038.sentence: The Bus Registry shall not base any payout on a measured relay or uptime performance score.
MPE-ECO-038.verify: inspection of payout circuit inputs; none is a score.

MPE-ECO-039.title: Treasury runway cap
MPE-ECO-039.sentence: Where a Bus Registry treasury is enabled, the Bus Registry shall pay out no more per day than the treasury balance divided by P-ECO-16.
MPE-ECO-039.verify: Quint invariant; devnet test that a payout above the cap fails.

MPE-ECO-040.title: Per-key saturation cap
MPE-ECO-040.sentence: Where a Bus Registry treasury is enabled, the Bus Registry shall pay any single bond key no more than the reward pool for that period divided by P-ECO-17.
MPE-ECO-040.verify: Quint invariant "payout per key ≤ pool ÷ k".

MPE-ECO-041.title: Store Node retention challenge
MPE-ECO-041.sentence: Where Store Node bonding is enabled, when the Bus Registry records a challenge for an anchored MPE Envelope inside its retention window, the Store Node shall submit that MPE Envelope and its Merkle path within P-ECO-18.
MPE-ECO-041.verify: devnet test: a challenge is issued and answered before the deadline.

MPE-ECO-042.title: Missed challenge forfeits bond
MPE-ECO-042.sentence: Where Store Node bonding is enabled, if a challenged Store Node misses the P-ECO-18 deadline, then the Bus Registry shall transfer the forfeited bond share to the challenger and the treasury.
MPE-ECO-042.verify: devnet test: an unanswered challenge produces the transfer after the deadline.

MPE-ECO-043.title: Unlinkable paid back-fill
MPE-ECO-043.sentence: Where a Store Node charges for back-fill, the Store Node shall accept payment tokens that carry no Subscriber account identifier.
MPE-ECO-043.verify: inspection of the redemption message format: no persistent client identifier is present.

MPE-ECO-044.title: Overload refuses new Envelopes
MPE-ECO-044.sentence: If accepting an MPE Envelope would exceed the Bus Node's configured ingress or storage cap, then the Bus Node shall refuse that MPE Envelope with GossipSub `Ignore` instead of evicting an unexpired accepted MPE Envelope.
MPE-ECO-044.verify: test: fill the store cap, then inject one more; the stored set is unchanged and the new Envelope gets `Ignore`.

MPE-ECO-045.title: Shed the largest class first
MPE-ECO-045.sentence: While the Bus Node's ingress exceeds its configured cap, the Bus Node shall refuse MPE Envelopes of the largest size class before refusing any smaller class.
MPE-ECO-045.verify: simulation at 2× the cap with a mixed class load: the refusal ratio for the largest class is ≥ that of every smaller class.

MPE-ECO-046.title: Cover Envelopes are admitted normally
MPE-ECO-046.sentence: Where a Bus Operator emits cover MPE Envelopes, the Bus Node shall apply the same Admission Proof and credit checks to them as to any other MPE Envelope.
MPE-ECO-046.verify: test: a cover Envelope without credits gets `Reject`.

MPE-ECO-047.title: Prototype admission over a mocked ledger
MPE-ECO-047.sentence: The Prototype shall run ECO-012 through ECO-024 against a mocked Ledger Adapter that supplies membership roots, root publication times and revocations.
MPE-ECO-047.verify: demonstration: the conformance suite passes with the mock adapter.

MPE-ECO-048.title: Admission-proof measurement gate
MPE-ECO-048.sentence: The Prototype shall report the Admission Proof size in bytes, the encoded Admission Slot width `roundUp64(104 + proof length)` and the verification time on one core of a 4-vCPU VM, and fail its gate if the slot width exceeds P-ECO-11 or the verification time exceeds P-ECO-12.
MPE-ECO-048.verify: test: a benchmark harness over 10,000 proofs reports median and p99 verify time and the proof length.

MPE-ECO-049.title: Registration-cost gate
MPE-ECO-049.sentence: MPE shall not enter production until a measured devnet registration transaction is within P-ECO-13.
MPE-ECO-049.verify: demonstration: submit 10 registrations on devnet and record bytes and DUST from the block's `ledgerParameters`; until then, the estimate uses the measured model inputs (proofs of at most 4,368 bytes, verifying keys of at most 2,119 bytes, simulator transcript gas), about 8.7 KB and 0.246 DUST.

MPE-ECO-050.title: Flood-cost analysis published
MPE-ECO-050.sentence: MPE shall publish, before production, the NIGHT holding needed to fill one Shard at its D5 cap for 24 h, computed from the ECO-049 measurement.
MPE-ECO-050.verify: analysis: an independent reviewer recomputes it from the published inputs using 0.714 DUST/NIGHT/day.

MPE-NET-002.title: Overlay at launch
MPE-NET-002.sentence: MPE shall carry MPE Envelopes over the GossipSub overlay from the first release stage.
MPE-NET-002.verify: demonstration. The Prototype delivers Envelopes with no Midnight transaction per Envelope.

MPE-NET-003.title: No node change
MPE-NET-003.sentence: MPE shall operate with an unmodified `midnight-node` binary, runtime and pallet set.
MPE-NET-003.verify: inspection. The Prototype runs against a stock local devnet node.

MPE-NET-004.title: Validators not required
MPE-NET-004.sentence: MPE shall deliver MPE Envelopes with no Bus Node running on any Midnight block-authoring host.
MPE-NET-004.verify: test (g2 D10). On a devnet, a capture on validator P2P ports shows zero MPE protocol ids, and stopping all Bus Nodes leaves GRANDPA finality unchanged.

MPE-NET-005.title: Distinct peer identity
MPE-NET-005.sentence: The Bus Node shall use a libp2p identity key distinct from the network key of any Midnight node on the same host.
MPE-NET-005.verify: test. The Prototype refuses to start when given the co-located node's network key file.

MPE-NET-006.title: Network-scoped names
MPE-NET-006.sentence: The Bus Node shall derive every MPE GossipSub topic name and request-response protocol identifier from the prefix `/mpe/<g>/1`, where `g` is the first eight bytes of the Midnight genesis hash in lowercase hexadecimal.
MPE-NET-006.verify: test. Two swarms with different genesis hashes share a bootstrapper, and no Envelope crosses between them; inspection: admission binds the full genesis hash, because the eight-byte prefix is a routing label, not an authenticated network identifier.

MPE-NET-007.title: Transport baseline
MPE-NET-007.sentence: The Bus Node shall support TCP with Noise encryption and Yamux multiplexing as its mandatory transport stack.
MPE-NET-007.verify: test. Two Prototype nodes built with only TCP, Noise and Yamux exchange Envelopes.

MPE-NET-008.title: GossipSub v1.2 profile with scoring
MPE-NET-008.sentence: The Bus Node shall relay MPE Envelopes using a GossipSub router with v1.1 peer scoring, extended application validation and the v1.2 IDONTWANT capability enabled.
MPE-NET-008.verify: inspection of the configuration and of the negotiated identifier `/meshsub/1.2.0`; test, per-peer scores appear in metrics and IDONTWANT is exchanged on v1.2 links but not on v1.1 links.
MPE-NET-008.note: The v1.2 specification is not final (revision r2, 30 August 2026). Compatibility with a v1.1 peer does not provide IDONTWANT on that connection.

MPE-NET-010.title: Wire-byte message id
MPE-NET-010.sentence: The Bus Node shall set the GossipSub message identifier to SHA-256 over the domain string `mpe/v1/msgid` and the complete MPE Envelope bytes carried as `Message.data`, including the Admission Slot and excluding all protobuf, RPC and transport framing.
MPE-NET-010.verify: test, two Envelopes differing only in the Admission Slot get distinct ids and one Envelope Identifier; identical bytes get one id; all implementations agree on test vectors and no data transform is configured.

MPE-NET-011.title: Mesh degree
MPE-NET-011.sentence: The Bus Node shall set `D`, `D_lo`, `D_hi` and `D_out` to P-NET-1, P-NET-2, P-NET-3 and P-NET-4, satisfying `D_lo` ≤ `D` ≤ `D_hi`, `D_out` < `D_lo` and `D_out` ≤ `D`/2.
MPE-NET-011.verify: inspection of the configuration dump, plus a test that a configuration violating any of the three constraints fails at startup; interoperability with the inspected Go implementation, whose validator requires `D_out` < `D`/2 and rejects (8, 6, 12, 4), is recorded as not established until tested.
MPE-NET-011.note: These are mesh maintenance targets. They guarantee neither a minimum degree nor a bound on all recipients: gossip, explicit peers, publication replenishment and opportunistic grafting add neighbours.

MPE-NET-012.title: Timing parameters
MPE-NET-012.sentence: The Bus Node shall set the heartbeat interval, gossip factor and prune backoff to P-NET-5, P-NET-6 and P-NET-7.

MPE-NET-013.title: Flood publishing off
MPE-NET-013.sentence: The Bus Node shall disable GossipSub flood publishing on every MPE GossipSub topic.
MPE-NET-013.verify: test. A node with 30 connected peers sends a fresh Envelope to at most P-NET-3 first-hop peers.

MPE-NET-014.title: Encoded RPC size cap
MPE-NET-014.sentence: If an encoded GossipSub RPC, including batched messages and control fields, exceeds P-NET-8 bytes, then the Bus Node shall drop it without forwarding.
MPE-NET-014.verify: test. An RPC of P-NET-8 + 1 bytes is neither delivered nor forwarded; inspection, Go peers set this limit explicitly instead of their 1 MiB default, and the application check of Envelope length is separate.

MPE-NET-015.title: Validate before forwarding
MPE-NET-015.sentence: The Bus Node shall forward an MPE Envelope's payload only after its application validator has returned Accept.
MPE-NET-015.verify: test. An Envelope held in validation is not seen by any downstream peer until Accept; inspection, identifier calculation, seen-cache entry, IDONTWANT and delivery bookkeeping may precede Accept and are documented as such.

MPE-NET-016.title: Reject outcome
MPE-NET-016.sentence: If an MPE Envelope fails a layout or admission check that does not depend on chain state, then the Bus Node shall return Reject.
MPE-NET-016.verify: test. Every entry of the FMT mutated-header list gets Reject, and the sender's P4 term falls.

MPE-NET-017.title: Ignore outcome
MPE-NET-017.sentence: If an MPE Envelope is a duplicate of an accepted MPE Envelope Identifier or expired on arrival, then the Bus Node shall return Ignore.
MPE-NET-017.verify: test, each case is neither forwarded nor penalised.

MPE-NET-018.title: Stale chain view never penalises
MPE-NET-018.sentence: While the Ledger Adapter view is stale, the Bus Node shall return Ignore instead of Reject for every MPE Envelope whose failed check depends on chain state or the local clock.
MPE-NET-018.verify: test, freeze the mock adapter; cached-valid Envelopes still reach Subscribers and no peer's P4 term changes.

MPE-NET-019.title: Clock and stall detection
MPE-NET-019.sentence: If the local clock and the latest finalized block timestamp differ by more than P-NET-13 seconds, then the Ledger Adapter shall mark its view stale.
MPE-NET-019.verify: test. Pause the mock chain, or shift the local clock by P-NET-13 + 1 s; the view becomes stale.

MPE-NET-020.title: Source disagreement
MPE-NET-020.sentence: If two configured chain sources report different Bus Registry admission roots for the same finalized block, then the Ledger Adapter shall mark its view stale.
MPE-NET-020.verify: test. Two mock sources diverge at one height; the view becomes stale and an alarm metric is raised.

MPE-NET-021.title: Score penalty signs
MPE-NET-021.sentence: The Bus Node shall configure negative weights for the invalid-message (P4) and IP-colocation (P6) score terms, with P6 threshold P-NET-15.
MPE-NET-021.verify: test. P-NET-15 + 2 peers on one IP all get a negative P6 contribution.

MPE-NET-022.title: Eviction of misbehaving peers
MPE-NET-022.sentence: When a mesh peer has delivered only Rejected MPE Envelopes, or no MPE Envelope within the GossipSub mesh-delivery window, for P-NET-16 consecutive heartbeats in each of which the Shard carried an accepted MPE Envelope, the Bus Node shall prune that peer from its mesh.
MPE-NET-022.verify: simulation with asymmetric latency and topology, slow honest peers, every supported Shard and at least 90 loaded heartbeats: withholding and invalid-only peers at 10 Envelopes/s are pruned within P-NET-16 heartbeats, no honest peer is pruned, and no peer is pruned in an idle Shard; the report states whether near-first deliveries were tracked or approximated by first deliveries.

MPE-NET-023.title: Per-peer per-Shard rate limit
MPE-NET-023.sentence: If a peer sends more than P-NET-10 MPE Envelopes per second on one Shard, then the Bus Node shall drop the excess with Ignore before proof verification.
MPE-NET-023.verify: test, at 5 x P-NET-10 from one peer on one Shard, verifier calls for that peer and Shard stay at or below P-NET-10 per second.

MPE-NET-024.title: Bootstrapper mode
MPE-NET-024.sentence: Where a Bus Node runs as a bootstrapper, it shall set `D`, `D_lo`, `D_hi` and `D_out` to zero and return at least one Peer Exchange candidate on every PRUNE.
MPE-NET-024.verify: test. A bootstrapper forwards no Envelopes and returns peer identifiers on PRUNE (`prune_peers` above zero); inspection, until this profile is demonstrated the reference bootstrappers relay and are reported as relaying.

MPE-NET-025.title: Bootstrapper set
MPE-NET-025.sentence: MPE shall publish at least P-NET-11 bootstrappers, each run by a distinct Bus Operator on a host that is not a Midnight chain bootnode.
MPE-NET-025.verify: inspection of the published list against Bus Operator records and `res/mainnet/bootnodes-config.json`.

MPE-NET-026.title: Bootstrap list authenticity
MPE-NET-026.sentence: When the Bus Node loads a bootstrap list, it shall verify the list hash against the bootstrap-list hash in the Bus Registry.
MPE-NET-026.verify: test. A list with one substituted address is refused and not dialed.

MPE-NET-027.title: Peer Exchange acceptance
MPE-NET-027.sentence: The Bus Node shall accept Peer Exchange suggestions only from peers whose score reaches `AcceptPXThreshold`, a value attainable only through the bootstrapper application score, and only for identities the Bus Registry authorizes.
MPE-NET-027.verify: test. Peer Exchange from a high-scoring non-bootstrapper is ignored, and a bootstrapper's suggestion of an identity absent from the Bus Registry relay list is not dialed.

MPE-NET-028.title: Outbound quota sources
MPE-NET-028.sentence: The Bus Node shall fill its `D_out` quota only with peers it dialed from the bootstrap list, bootstrapper Peer Exchange or the Bus Registry relay list, after the same authentication and address checks for every dial source.
MPE-NET-028.verify: test. With a DHT full of attacker ids, every `D_out` slot holds a non-DHT peer, and a suggested private or unauthenticated address is not dialed.

MPE-NET-029.title: No local-network discovery
MPE-NET-029.sentence: While running outside a development profile, the Bus Node shall not discover or dial peers on private, link-local or loopback addresses.
MPE-NET-029.verify: test. Production profile: no mDNS traffic, and private-address dials are refused.

MPE-NET-030.title: Warm-up before injection
MPE-NET-030.sentence: While the Bus Node has not held at least `D_out` outbound mesh peers continuously for P-NET-12 seconds, it shall refuse local client publications with a not-ready error.
MPE-NET-030.verify: test. A publication during warm-up returns not-ready and is not injected.

MPE-NET-031.title: Shard GossipSub topics from the Bus Registry
MPE-NET-031.sentence: The Bus Node shall subscribe to the Shard GossipSub topics defined by the shard count P-NET-9 read from the Bus Registry.
MPE-NET-031.verify: test. Changing the mock Bus Registry value changes the subscribed GossipSub topic set.

MPE-NET-032.title: Shard-count transition
MPE-NET-032.sentence: When the Bus Registry shard count changes, the Bus Node shall keep relaying the previous Shard GossipSub topics until the maximum MPE Envelope lifetime has elapsed after the activation height.
MPE-NET-032.verify: test. An Envelope published under the old mapping just before activation is still delivered.

MPE-NET-033.title: Publish ingress hop
MPE-NET-033.sentence: When the MPE client library publishes an MPE Envelope, it shall send it to exactly one Bus Node chosen at random from at least two Bus Nodes the client dialed itself.
MPE-NET-033.verify: test. Across 1,000 publications, each one reaches exactly one first Bus Node, and the choice spans at least two nodes.

MPE-NET-034.title: Relay allow-list
MPE-NET-034.sentence: Where the relay allow-list is enabled, the Bus Node shall exclude from its mesh every peer whose identity is absent from the Bus Registry relay list.
MPE-NET-034.verify: test. GRAFT from an unlisted peer is refused, and a removed relay with a positive topic score leaves every mesh; inspection, exclusion does not rely on the -20 application score alone, since topic contributions of up to 32 can offset it.

MPE-NET-035.title: Ledger Adapter interface
MPE-NET-035.sentence: The Ledger Adapter shall expose finalized Bus Registry reads and Midnight transaction submission through one interface that has a mock implementation.
MPE-NET-035.verify: test. The full Prototype suite passes against the mock adapter, and a subset passes against a devnet adapter.

MPE-NET-036.title: Finalized state only
MPE-NET-036.sentence: The Ledger Adapter shall return Bus Registry state only from finalized blocks.
MPE-NET-036.verify: test. A Bus Registry write that is included but not finalized is invisible to the adapter.

MPE-NET-037.title: Contract-state read path
MPE-NET-037.sentence: The Ledger Adapter shall obtain admission roots and network parameters from Bus Registry contract state without depending on `contractEvents`.
MPE-NET-037.verify: demonstration. The adapter reads a root via `midnight_contractState` on a ledger-8 devnet.

MPE-NET-038.title: Relaying during a governance pause
MPE-NET-038.sentence: While safe mode filters Midnight user transactions, the Bus Node shall keep relaying MPE Envelopes admitted under previously accepted Bus Registry roots until those admissions expire.
MPE-NET-038.verify: test. With safe mode entered on a devnet, existing admissions deliver and new registrations fail.

MPE-NET-039.title: Bus Registry fields
MPE-NET-039.sentence: The Bus Registry shall expose as public ledger state the shard count, its activation height, the maximum MPE protocol version, the current admission root and the bootstrap-list hash.
MPE-NET-039.verify: inspection of the contract, plus a test that the adapter reads each field.

MPE-NET-040.title: Fixed `Misc` names
MPE-NET-040.sentence: The Bus Registry shall emit only `Misc` events, each named `mip-xxxx:anchor[v1]` or `mip-xxxx:governance[v1]` and NUL-padded to 32 bytes.
MPE-NET-040.verify: inspection of every `emit` site, plus a test over 100 emits showing one distinct `name` per event kind and no `Paused` or `Unpaused` standard event.

MPE-NET-041.title: Anchor cadence
MPE-NET-041.sentence: Where a Bus Node acts as anchorer, the Bus Node shall submit at most one Anchor per non-empty P-NET-17 window, covering every Shard.
MPE-NET-041.verify: test, ten windows with three empty ones produce seven Anchors, each listing all Shards' counts.

MPE-NET-042.title: Explicit carrier label
MPE-NET-042.sentence: When the MPE client library carries a Message over a path other than the overlay, it shall label that Message with the carrier it used for the Consumer.
MPE-NET-042.verify: test. With the overlay disabled, every delivered Message carries a non-overlay label.

MPE-NET-044.title: Ledger lane
MPE-NET-044.sentence: Where the ledger lane is enabled, the MPE client library shall publish each MPE Envelope on the ledger lane as the 4^c `Misc` parts of MPE-FMT-041, all named `mip-xxxx:envelope[v1]`.
MPE-NET-044.verify: test on a ledger-9 devnet: ledger-lane publications of classes 0, 1 and 2 show 1, 4 and 16 parts with one `name` and 256-byte payloads.

MPE-NET-045.title: Unmodified Indexer
MPE-NET-045.sentence: The Indexer adapter shall use only queries and subscriptions present in the unmodified Indexer `schema-v4` API.
MPE-NET-045.verify: inspection. Every GraphQL operation in the adapter validates against `schema-v4.graphql`.

MPE-NET-046.title: Unmodified Compact toolchain
MPE-NET-046.sentence: The Prototype shall build its Bus Registry contract with an unmodified released Compact toolchain.
MPE-NET-046.verify: inspection. The build log names a released toolchain version with no patches.

MPE-NET-047.title: IDONTWANT measurement
MPE-NET-047.sentence: The Prototype shall report per-Bus-Node bytes sent with GossipSub v1.2 IDONTWANT enabled at threshold P-NET-18 and with IDONTWANT disabled.
MPE-NET-047.verify: test. Paired runs report the egress difference per size class and state which behaviour was disabled: a Rust emission threshold of 65,537 B suppresses emission only, not receipt or honouring of notices.

MPE-PRF-001.title: Complete traffic accounting
MPE-PRF-001.sentence: The Prototype shall report traffic accounting that distinguishes logical Messages, unique MPE Envelopes, recipient copies, fragments, admission traffic, duplicates, overlay control traffic, back-fill traffic and transport overhead.
MPE-PRF-001.verify: inspection, reconcile accounting categories with generated traffic and captured bytes.

MPE-PRF-002.title: Reproducible benchmark manifest
MPE-PRF-002.sentence: The Prototype shall produce a manifest for each performance run specifying software revisions, hardware, MPE Envelope sizes, admission mechanism, topology, mesh settings, workload, connection state, impairments, measurement interval and random seed.
MPE-PRF-002.verify: inspection, reproduce a run from its manifest.

MPE-PRF-003.title: Percentiles with delivery denominators
MPE-PRF-003.sentence: The Prototype shall report p50, p95 and p99 latency distributions with their eligible-delivery counts, completed-delivery counts, losses, timeouts and observation deadlines.
MPE-PRF-003.verify: test, inject omissions and confirm they remain visible alongside the percentile results.

MPE-PRF-004.title: Separate latency stages
MPE-PRF-004.sentence: The Prototype shall report separate latency distributions for authorization, publication preparation, relay propagation, Subscriber delivery, recognition, back-fill, Anchor submission, transaction inclusion, finality, indexing and contract reaction.
MPE-PRF-004.verify: inspection, reconcile stage timestamps with end-to-end samples and identify mocked stages.

MPE-PRF-005.title: Measured propagation amplification
MPE-PRF-005.sentence: The Prototype shall report per-Bus-Node receive and transmit amplification as measured wire bytes divided by unique accepted MPE Envelope bytes.
MPE-PRF-005.verify: analysis, reconcile directional amplification with packet captures and unique-byte counters.

MPE-PRF-006.title: Sustained Shard capacity
MPE-PRF-006.sentence: While Reference conditions hold, MPE shall deliver at least P-VER-7 of eligible MPE Envelope-Subscriber pairs within P-VER-6 for an offered load of min(P-PRF-1, P-PRF-2 divided by mean complete MPE Envelope size) MPE Envelopes per second per Shard sustained for P-VER-3.
MPE-PRF-006.verify: test, run count-bound (class 0) and byte-bound (class 3) workloads and compute the delivery fraction per MPE-VER-014.

MPE-PRF-007.title: Normal-load delivery
MPE-PRF-007.sentence: While Reference conditions hold at the sustained Shard capacity, MPE shall deliver every accepted MPE Envelope to every continuously connected eligible Subscriber within P-VER-6 after admission.
MPE-PRF-007.verify: test, compare accepted identifiers with each Subscriber's received identifiers and timestamps.

MPE-PRF-008.title: Median warm propagation
MPE-PRF-008.sentence: While Reference conditions hold at the sustained Shard capacity, MPE shall keep warm relay propagation p50 at or below P-PRF-10.
MPE-PRF-008.verify: test, calculate p50 using the warm propagation clock defined below.

MPE-PRF-009.title: Tail warm propagation
MPE-PRF-009.sentence: While Reference conditions hold at the sustained Shard capacity, MPE shall keep warm relay propagation p99 at or below P-PRF-11.
MPE-PRF-009.verify: test, calculate p99 alongside the delivery denominator.

MPE-PRF-010.title: Mesh profile comparison
MPE-PRF-010.sentence: The Prototype shall benchmark the GossipSub v1.2 profile using each P-PRF-4 mesh tuple with P-PRF-5, P-PRF-6, P-PRF-7 and P-PRF-8 explicitly configured.
MPE-PRF-010.verify: simulation, compare delivery, percentiles, amplification and CPU under identical workloads; each tuple satisfies the mesh constraints of MPE-NET-011, and gossip and publication recipients are counted separately from mesh degree.

MPE-PRF-011.title: Gossip-factor retry
MPE-PRF-011.sentence: If the default mesh misses the warm propagation p99 target, then the Prototype shall repeat the failing workload with the alternative P-PRF-5 gossip factor.
MPE-PRF-011.verify: simulation, reproduce the failure and compare the repeated run.

MPE-PRF-012.title: Degree-transient cost
MPE-PRF-012.sentence: The Prototype shall measure resource consumption during mesh oversubscription and pruning at the configured P-PRF-4 high-water degree.
MPE-PRF-012.verify: simulation, correlate observed mesh degree with traffic, CPU and queue peaks.

MPE-PRF-013.title: Edge bandwidth budget
MPE-PRF-013.sentence: While Reference conditions hold at the sustained Shard capacity, the Bus Node operating as an Edge Bus Node shall consume no more than P-PRF-12 of bus bandwidth in each direction.
MPE-PRF-013.verify: test, capture receive and transmit separately over the steady interval.

MPE-PRF-014.title: Full bandwidth budget
MPE-PRF-014.sentence: While Reference conditions hold with P-PRF-16 Shards at their sustained capacity, the Bus Node operating as a Full Bus Node shall consume no more than P-PRF-13 of bus bandwidth in each direction.
MPE-PRF-014.verify: test, capture receive and transmit separately with all allocated Shards active.

MPE-PRF-015.title: Edge CPU budget
MPE-PRF-015.sentence: While Reference conditions hold at the sustained Shard capacity, the Bus Node operating as an Edge Bus Node shall consume no more than P-PRF-14 cores for bus processing.
MPE-PRF-015.verify: test, measure process CPU on declared reference hardware.

MPE-PRF-016.title: Full CPU budget
MPE-PRF-016.sentence: While Reference conditions hold with P-PRF-16 Shards at their sustained capacity, the Bus Node operating as a Full Bus Node shall consume no more than P-PRF-15 cores for bus processing.
MPE-PRF-016.verify: test, measure process CPU with all allocated Shards active.

MPE-PRF-017.title: Admission validation benchmark
MPE-PRF-017.sentence: The Prototype shall report wall-clock Admission Proof validation costs for valid, invalid, duplicate, cached and uncached inputs on each tested Bus Node hardware class.
MPE-PRF-017.verify: test, report distributions, CPU consumption and cache-hit rates for the selected admission implementation.

MPE-PRF-018.title: Publication preparation benchmark
MPE-PRF-018.sentence: The Prototype shall report publication preparation costs on server, laptop and mobile hardware for the selected Admission Proof mechanism.
MPE-PRF-018.verify: test, measure generation latency, CPU and serialized bytes, marking unavailable implementations unknown; state for each hardware class whether proof generation runs locally.

MPE-PRF-019.title: Desktop recognition budget
MPE-PRF-019.sentence: While the desktop recognition profile P-PRF-19 is active, the MPE client library shall consume no more than P-PRF-20 cores for recognition.
MPE-PRF-019.verify: test, measure matching and nonmatching traffic with the declared recognition keys.

MPE-PRF-020.title: Mobile recognition boundary
MPE-PRF-020.sentence: Where whole-Shard recognition on mobile hardware is present, the MPE client library shall satisfy the P-PRF-21 recognition CPU budget.
MPE-PRF-020.verify: test, measure recognition CPU on a named device using the declared one-key fixture.

MPE-PRF-021.title: Subscriber download cost
MPE-PRF-021.sentence: The Prototype shall report measured Subscriber download bytes per delivered MPE Envelope and the resulting daily volume for every supported subscription profile.
MPE-PRF-021.verify: analysis, reconcile captures with daily extrapolations and disclose the extrapolation workload.

MPE-PRF-022.title: Edge stream concurrency
MPE-PRF-022.sentence: The Bus Node operating as an Edge Bus Node shall limit active full-Shard streams to P-PRF-17.
MPE-PRF-022.verify: test, request one stream beyond the limit and confirm refusal.

MPE-PRF-023.title: Gateway Subscriber capacity
MPE-PRF-023.sentence: While Reference conditions hold on one Shard at its sustained capacity, MPE shall deliver at least P-VER-7 of that Shard's accepted MPE Envelopes within P-VER-6 to each of the P-PRF-18 concurrently connected Subscribers.
MPE-PRF-023.verify: demonstration, run the gateway topology and compute per-Subscriber delivery fractions.

MPE-PRF-024.title: Gateway resource curve
MPE-PRF-024.sentence: The Prototype shall report gateway CPU, memory, egress and delivery latency as Subscriber concurrency rises through the P-PRF-18 topology.
MPE-PRF-024.verify: test, identify the first saturated resource and associated delivery degradation.

MPE-PRF-025.title: Fifty-per-second comparison
MPE-PRF-025.sentence: The Prototype shall execute P-PRF-28 as a separately reported comparison workload.
MPE-PRF-025.verify: test, compare measured bandwidth, CPU and latency with g1’s corrected estimates and stated gates.

MPE-PRF-026.title: Aggregate load ladder
MPE-PRF-026.sentence: The Prototype shall execute every P-PRF-30 aggregate load on the P-PRF-3 Shard topology.
MPE-PRF-026.verify: simulation, report offered rate, accepted rate and delivered rate per Shard.

MPE-PRF-027.title: Burst workloads
MPE-PRF-027.sentence: The Prototype shall execute every P-PRF-29 burst for P-PRF-26.
MPE-PRF-027.verify: test, report rejection, queue peaks, delivery tails and post-burst drain behavior.

MPE-PRF-028.title: Shard concentration
MPE-PRF-028.sentence: The Prototype shall repeat each aggregate load with all offered publications concentrated on one Shard.
MPE-PRF-028.verify: simulation, compare the concentrated run against its uniform counterpart.

MPE-PRF-029.title: Recovery contention
MPE-PRF-029.sentence: While live delivery shares resources with Store Node back-fill, the Prototype shall measure performance under P-PRF-31.
MPE-PRF-029.verify: test, record the live/back-fill split and its effects on live delivery.

MPE-PRF-030.title: Admission window synchronization burst
MPE-PRF-030.sentence: The Prototype shall measure performance when P-PRF-32 Publishers submit valid publications at the same admission window boundary.
MPE-PRF-030.verify: test, compare queue growth and latency against an evenly distributed publication schedule.

MPE-PRF-031.title: Invalid-ingress resource cost
MPE-PRF-031.sentence: The Prototype shall report invalid-ingress resource consumption separately from accepted-Envelope resource consumption during the SEC-defined abuse workloads.
MPE-PRF-031.verify: test, attribute CPU, ingress bytes and queue occupancy to invalid input categories.

MPE-PRF-032.title: Attack delivery floor
MPE-PRF-032.sentence: While the P-PRF-22 cold-start attack is active at the nominal offered load, MPE shall deliver at least P-PRF-23 of eligible honest MPE Envelope deliveries.
MPE-PRF-032.verify: simulation, measure delivery among continuously connected honest recipients at each tested network size.

MPE-PRF-033.title: Attack propagation tail
MPE-PRF-033.sentence: While the P-PRF-22 cold-start attack is active at the nominal offered load, MPE shall keep completed honest relay propagation p99 at or below P-PRF-24.
MPE-PRF-033.verify: simulation, calculate p99 with the losses reported under MPE-PRF-032.

MPE-PRF-034.title: Queue overflow response
MPE-PRF-034.sentence: If admitting another publication would exceed a P-PRF-27 queue bound, then the Bus Node shall refuse that publication.
MPE-PRF-034.verify: test, fill each declared count or byte bound and confirm additional work is refused.

MPE-PRF-035.title: Explicit capacity failure
MPE-PRF-035.sentence: When a Publisher publication is refused because of capacity exhaustion, the Bus Node shall return an explicit capacity-exhausted result to the Publisher.
MPE-PRF-035.verify: test, exhaust capacity and inspect the Publisher-facing result.

MPE-PRF-036.title: Stream bandwidth refusal
MPE-PRF-036.sentence: If serving another full-Shard stream would exceed its class bandwidth budget, then the Bus Node shall refuse the additional stream.
MPE-PRF-036.verify: test, exhaust the measured stream budget before the socket limit.

MPE-PRF-037.title: Sustained soak
MPE-PRF-037.sentence: The Prototype shall run the recommended operating workload continuously for P-PRF-25.
MPE-PRF-037.verify: test, inspect resource time series and delivery outcomes throughout the soak.

MPE-PRF-038.title: Performance stop classification
MPE-PRF-038.sentence: If delivery falls below P-PRF-23 or relay propagation p99 exceeds P-PRF-24 with 200 Bus Nodes, then the Prototype shall classify that configuration as failing the overlay performance gate.
MPE-PRF-038.verify: test, feed each failing result into the acceptance report and confirm failure classification.

MPE-PRF-039.title: Indexer fan-out comparison
MPE-PRF-039.sentence: Where an Indexer fallback is present, the Prototype shall benchmark the P-PRF-33 workload.
MPE-PRF-039.verify: test, measure query rate, CPU, response bytes and fan-out latency after indexing.

MPE-PRF-040.title: Measured ledger-lane capacity
MPE-PRF-040.sentence: The Prototype shall report the ledger-lane throughput ceiling under both the `block_usage` and the `bytes_written` block limits, using the measured serialized size of one `Misc` event and of 1-, 4- and 16-part groups.
MPE-PRF-040.verify: analysis, show both limit calculations with MIP-0002's 40-byte overhead (about 6.3 class-1 and 1.5 class-2 Envelopes per second for the whole chain at 50,000 B of `bytes_written` per block), identify the binding limit and record which `block_usage` value (200,000 or 1,000,000) is live.

MPE-STO-001.title: No bodies in ledger state
MPE-STO-001.sentence: The Bus Registry shall store no Message body and no Sealed Body in contract state.
MPE-STO-001.verify: inspection, review the Bus Registry's state declarations and captured state writes.

MPE-STO-002.title: Shard-scoped commitments
MPE-STO-002.sentence: The Store Node shall scope each retention commitment to a named Shard.
MPE-STO-002.verify: test, commit retention for one Shard without creating retention obligations for another.

MPE-STO-003.title: Reject excessive ordinary retention
MPE-STO-003.sentence: If a received MPE Envelope's expiry exceeds the Store Node's clock plus P-FMT-3 plus P-FMT-4, then the Store Node shall reject its storage admission.
MPE-STO-003.verify: test, admission just below, at and above the limit.

MPE-STO-004.title: Retain accepted Envelopes
MPE-STO-004.sentence: When an ordinary MPE Envelope is accepted for storage, the Store Node shall retain it until its authenticated retention deadline unless an authorized tombstone applies.
MPE-STO-004.verify: test, retrieve committed Envelopes throughout their window across process restarts.

MPE-STO-005.title: Complete verification material
MPE-STO-005.sentence: The Store Node shall retain the complete MPE Envelope verification material throughout its retention commitment.
MPE-STO-005.verify: demonstration, verify a retrieved Envelope with a fresh client lacking the Store Node’s verification cache.

MPE-STO-006.title: Retrieval does not refresh retention
MPE-STO-006.sentence: When an MPE Envelope is retrieved or received again, the Store Node shall preserve its existing retention deadline.
MPE-STO-006.verify: test, repeatedly retrieve and replay an Envelope near its deadline without extending retention.

MPE-STO-007.title: Expiry pruning
MPE-STO-007.sentence: When an MPE Envelope’s retention commitment expires, the Store Node shall remove its record from managed live storage within P-STO-2.
MPE-STO-007.verify: test, advance the clock beyond expiry and inspect live records after the pruning allowance.

MPE-STO-008.title: Per-Shard disk bound
MPE-STO-008.sentence: The Store Node shall keep its allocated storage for each retained Shard at or below P-STO-3.
MPE-STO-008.verify: test, measure allocated files during sustained ingest, pruning and compaction at the configured limit.

MPE-STO-009.title: Refuse storage overload
MPE-STO-009.sentence: If accepting an MPE Envelope would exceed its Shard’s P-STO-3 allocation, then the Store Node shall reject that storage admission with `STORAGE_FULL`.
MPE-STO-009.verify: test, fill the allocation and confirm explicit refusal while previously committed Envelopes remain retrievable.

MPE-STO-010.title: Refuse cache overload
MPE-STO-010.sentence: If live admission would exceed P-STO-4 for application storage caches, then the Bus Node shall reject that admission with `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED`.
MPE-STO-010.verify: test, exhaust cache allocation and confirm rejection without eviction of unexpired protection records.

MPE-STO-011.title: Receipt follows persistence
MPE-STO-011.sentence: When the Store Node issues a retention receipt, the Store Node shall sign it only after committing the identified MPE Envelope to storage recoverable after process restart.
MPE-STO-011.verify: test, interrupt the process around receipt issuance and recover every Envelope covered by an issued receipt.

MPE-STO-012.title: Stored attribute
MPE-STO-012.sentence: The MPE client library shall mark a delivered Message `stored` only after validating compatible retention receipts from at least P-STO-5 distinct Bus Operators.
MPE-STO-012.verify: test, reject duplicate Bus Operator receipts and receipts naming different Envelopes or deadlines.

MPE-STO-013.title: Application identifier cache
MPE-STO-013.sentence: The Bus Node shall retain each accepted proof-independent MPE Envelope Identifier in its application deduplication state until that MPE Envelope's expiry plus P-FMT-4, independently of the GossipSub seen cache.
MPE-STO-013.verify: test, replay an Envelope after transport-cache eviction but before application-state expiry and confirm duplicate recognition.

MPE-STO-014.title: Admission replay retention
MPE-STO-014.sentence: The Bus Node shall retain each consumed admission replay identifier until the latest time at which its authorization can pass the live-admission predicate.
MPE-STO-014.verify: test, attempt reuse across every accepted admission window boundary and after the authorization becomes permanently ineligible.

MPE-STO-015.title: Restart barrier
MPE-STO-015.sentence: While less than P-ECO-7 has elapsed since the Bus Node process started, the Bus Node shall return Ignore for every MPE Envelope requiring live admission.
MPE-STO-015.verify: test, restart in the middle of an admission window and replay a pre-restart Envelope at 1 s and at P-ECO-7 + 1 s; neither is accepted live.

MPE-STO-016.title: Historical admission context
MPE-STO-016.sentence: When serving back-fill, the Store Node shall provide the retained context needed to validate the MPE Envelope’s Admission Proof against its historical Bus Registry state.
MPE-STO-016.verify: demonstration, retrieve after Bus Registry membership rotation and independently validate the original admission.

MPE-STO-017.title: Recognition-independent requests
MPE-STO-017.sentence: When requesting back-fill, the MPE client library shall request complete intervals of its selected Shards without selecting MPE Envelopes by recognition results.
MPE-STO-017.verify: test, compare requests from clients with different recognition keys but identical Shard and interval selections.

MPE-STO-018.title: Complete retained interval
MPE-STO-018.sentence: When an authorized back-fill request covers an available interval, the Store Node shall return every retained MPE Envelope in that interval across its paginated response.
MPE-STO-018.verify: test, compare all returned pages with a seeded inventory using inclusive start and exclusive end boundaries.

MPE-STO-019.title: Explicit unavailable ranges
MPE-STO-019.sentence: If a back-fill request includes a known unavailable interval, then the Store Node shall identify that interval in a `RETENTION_GAP` response.
MPE-STO-019.verify: test, request across expired, deleted and known lost intervals and inspect the reported boundaries.

MPE-STO-020.title: Corrupt stored records
MPE-STO-020.sentence: If a stored MPE Envelope fails its identifier or retained verification checks, then the Store Node shall return `CORRUPT_RECORD` for the affected record.
MPE-STO-020.verify: test, mutate retained body and Admission Proof bytes and confirm a failure response instead of valid Envelope delivery.

MPE-STO-021.title: Bounded optional archives
MPE-STO-021.sentence: Where an archive service is present, the Store Node shall retain archived MPE Envelopes only through their separately agreed deadlines within P-STO-7.
MPE-STO-021.verify: inspection, inspect archive agreements and demonstrate removal from managed archive storage after their deadlines.

MPE-STO-022.title: Recoverable history capability
MPE-STO-022.sentence: When a Subscriber queries recovery capabilities, the MPE client library shall report recoverable history as the intersection of advertised remote retention coverage and locally available decryption-state coverage.
MPE-STO-022.verify: test, independently shorten remote retention and local key coverage and check the reported intersection.

MPE-STO-023.title: Client payload cache bound
MPE-STO-023.sentence: The MPE client library shall limit its local Message payload cache to P-STO-8.
MPE-STO-023.verify: test, exceed the configured payload allocation, including a zero allocation, and measure retained payload bytes.

MPE-STO-024.title: Discard unmatched Envelopes
MPE-STO-024.sentence: When local recognition of an unmatched MPE Envelope completes, the MPE client library shall discard its MPE Envelope bytes from the recognition buffer.
MPE-STO-024.verify: test, process an unmatched interval and inspect recognition-buffer contents after completion.

MPE-STO-025.title: Durable recovery checkpoint
MPE-STO-025.sentence: When committing a recovery checkpoint, the MPE client library shall persist its cursor and corresponding logical deduplication state as one atomic checkpoint.
MPE-STO-025.verify: test, inject failures during checkpoint persistence and recover either the preceding or completed checkpoint.

MPE-STO-026.title: Missing recovery keys
MPE-STO-026.sentence: If retained ciphertext requires decryption state that is unavailable, then the MPE client library shall report `KEY_GAP` for the affected recovery range.
MPE-STO-026.verify: test, remove required recovery keys while preserving remote Envelopes and confirm an explicit key-gap result.

MPE-STO-027.title: Unknown Indexer retention
MPE-STO-027.sentence: If contract-event retention coverage has not been established for an Indexer, then the Indexer adapter shall report that coverage as `unknown`.
MPE-STO-027.verify: test, configure only ledger-state retention and confirm that no contract-event retention guarantee is inferred.

MPE-STO-028.title: Anchor ring of fixed size
MPE-STO-028.sentence: The Bus Registry shall store live Anchor records in P-STO-10 slots indexed by window number modulo P-STO-10, each new record replacing the record P-STO-10 windows older.
MPE-STO-028.verify: test, insert beyond 2,940 windows and confirm that the reachable live Anchor state never exceeds 2,940 records and that a slot holding the same or a newer window refuses the post.

MPE-STO-029.title: Permissionless Anchor pruning
MPE-STO-029.sentence: When any caller requests removal of an Anchor record older than P-STO-9, the Bus Registry shall remove that record from its live Anchor state.
MPE-STO-029.verify: test, advance ledger time, prune by slot from an unprivileged caller and confirm removal; a request for a younger record fails.

MPE-STO-030.title: Measure Anchor storage
MPE-STO-030.sentence: The Prototype shall report reachable live Anchor-state bytes after each insertion, replacement and pruning operation during a run exceeding P-STO-10 insertions.
MPE-STO-030.verify: demonstration, publish a revision-qualified ledger-9 measurement showing state growth before and after capacity is reached.

MPE-STO-031.title: Per-Shard Bus Operator replication
MPE-STO-031.sentence: While a Shard advertises ordinary back-fill service, the MPE shall maintain storage commitments for that Shard from at least P-STO-5 distinct Bus Operators.
MPE-STO-031.verify: inspection, audit Bus Operator ownership and active Shard retention commitments.

MPE-STO-032.title: Measured retention availability
MPE-STO-032.sentence: While a Shard advertises ordinary back-fill service, the MPE shall achieve at least P-STO-12 successful scheduled canary retrievals at P-STO-11 intervals during each P-STO-13 assessment interval.
MPE-STO-032.verify: analysis, calculate success from scheduled probes, counting unavailable Envelopes, corrupt results and timeouts as failures.

MPE-STO-033.title: Storage failure experiments
MPE-STO-033.sentence: The Prototype shall report within-retention retrieval outcomes for experiments covering individual Store Node loss, correlated Bus Operator loss and partitions extending beyond retention.
MPE-STO-033.verify: simulation, compare retained inventories with recovered inventories under each named failure condition.

MPE-STO-034.title: Measure storage by node class
MPE-STO-034.sentence: The Prototype shall report peak storage allocations by node class under the PRF workload profiles, separately accounting for MPE Envelope bytes, indexes, caches, replay state and database temporary files.
MPE-STO-034.verify: demonstration, reconcile measured totals for Bus Nodes, Store Nodes and clients with their configured allocations.

MPE-STO-035.title: Auxiliary state pruning
MPE-STO-035.sentence: When an application cache record’s protection or verification lifetime ends, the Bus Node shall remove that record within P-STO-2.
MPE-STO-035.verify: test, expire each cache class and inspect its records after the pruning allowance.

MPE-STO-036.title: Authorized tombstone deletion
MPE-STO-036.sentence: Where the authorized tombstone feature is enabled, the Store Node shall remove the identified MPE Envelope from managed live storage within P-STO-14 after validating the tombstone.
MPE-STO-036.verify: test, apply a valid OPS-authorized tombstone and inspect storage after its deadline.

MPE-STO-037.title: Reject unauthorized deletion
MPE-STO-037.sentence: If an MPE Envelope deletion request fails the configured authorization policy, then the Store Node shall reject that request.
MPE-STO-037.verify: test, submit forged, malformed and unauthorized deletion requests and confirm retained records remain intact.

MPE-STO-038.title: Prevent tombstone reinsertion
MPE-STO-038.sentence: Where the authorized tombstone feature is enabled, the Store Node shall reject reinsertion of a tombstoned MPE Envelope until its latest otherwise-authorized retention deadline has passed.
MPE-STO-038.verify: test, replay deleted Envelopes through live ingress and archive ingestion before the applicable deadline.

MPE-STO-039.title: Separate inclusion and storage evidence
MPE-STO-039.sentence: The MPE client library shall expose Anchor inclusion evidence separately from retention commitment evidence.
MPE-STO-039.verify: test, supply an Anchor opening without retention receipts and confirm that inclusion does not imply the `stored` label.

MPE-STO-040.title: Verification cache validity
MPE-STO-040.sentence: If an Admission Proof verification-cache entry no longer matches the applicable proof bytes, verifier version or Bus Registry context, then the Bus Node shall invalidate that entry.
MPE-STO-040.verify: test, independently change proof bytes, verifier version and Bus Registry context and confirm fresh validation is required.

MPE-OPS-001.title: No validator duty
MPE-OPS-001.sentence: MPE shall assign no relay, store, anchoring or bootstrapping duty to a Midnight block-authoring node.
MPE-OPS-001.verify: test. On a testnet validator, a packet capture on the consensus port shows no MPE protocol id, and stopping every Bus Node leaves GRANDPA finality time unchanged (g2 Stage 1).

MPE-OPS-002.title: Separate network identity
MPE-OPS-002.sentence: The Bus Node shall use a libp2p identity key distinct from every peer key and session key of any co-located midnight-node.
MPE-OPS-002.verify: test. Run the Prototype beside a node and check that the two `identify` responses carry different public keys.

MPE-OPS-003.title: Separate bootstrap set
MPE-OPS-003.sentence: The Bus Node shall bootstrap only from a published list of at least P-OPS-3 MPE bootstrappers that contains no Midnight chain bootnode.
MPE-OPS-003.verify: inspection of the shipped list against the chain-spec bootnodes, plus a Prototype config-load test.

MPE-OPS-004.title: Bootstrapper profile
MPE-OPS-004.sentence: Where a Bus Node runs as a bootstrapper, the Bus Node shall apply the zero-degree bootstrapper profile of MPE-NET-024, with dial addresses taken from Bus Registry and authenticated bootstrap records.
MPE-OPS-004.verify: test. A bootstrapper's mesh stays empty over 1 h while Peer Exchange responses carry peer identifiers; signed-record Peer Exchange is not claimed for the reference implementation.

MPE-OPS-005.title: Role trust disclosure
MPE-OPS-005.sentence: MPE shall publish, before the first Bus Operator is admitted, a statement for each Bus Operator role of what that role observes and what it can withhold, delay or forge.
MPE-OPS-005.verify: inspection. Every role in the Glossary has a published statement.

MPE-OPS-006.title: Content-blind roles
MPE-OPS-006.sentence: MPE shall define no Bus Operator role or governance role that holds a key able to open an MPE Envelope body.
MPE-OPS-006.verify: inspection of the role definitions and key inventory; analysis of the Bus Registry operations.

MPE-OPS-007.title: Allow-listed mesh at launch
MPE-OPS-007.sentence: While the relay allow-list is active, the Bus Node shall accept GRAFT only from peers whose identity is on the Bus Registry relay list.
MPE-OPS-007.verify: test. A non-listed Prototype peer that sends GRAFT is pruned, while it can still publish as a non-mesh peer.

MPE-OPS-008.title: Allow-list removal gate
MPE-OPS-008.sentence: MPE shall keep the relay allow-list active until a red-team holding P-OPS-4 peer identities fails to push honest delivery below P-OPS-5 under the production scoring parameters.
MPE-OPS-008.verify: simulation and demonstration. A red-team run on the Stage 1 network with targeted placement at 1, 3 and 5 % (s3 D10).

MPE-OPS-009.title: Launch Bus Operator count
MPE-OPS-009.sentence: While the relay allow-list is active, MPE shall list relays run by at least P-OPS-1 independent organizations.
MPE-OPS-009.verify: inspection of the roster against Bus Operator attestations.

MPE-OPS-010.title: Concentration cap
MPE-OPS-010.sentence: MPE shall keep the share of listed relays run by any one organization at or below P-OPS-2.
MPE-OPS-010.verify: inspection of the roster each time the Bus Registry relay list changes.

MPE-OPS-011.title: Gates counted per organization
MPE-OPS-011.sentence: MPE shall compute every decentralization-gate metric per verified organization, not per peer identity or bond key.
MPE-OPS-011.verify: inspection of the gate report method.

MPE-OPS-012.title: Parameter time-lock
MPE-OPS-012.sentence: When a Bus Registry parameter change is approved, the Bus Registry shall defer its effect by at least P-OPS-6.
MPE-OPS-012.verify: analysis using the Quint invariant I1 "no parameter takes effect before its delay" (o4), plus a devnet test.

MPE-OPS-013.title: Emergency expiry
MPE-OPS-013.sentence: If an emergency action is not ratified within P-OPS-7, then the Bus Registry shall restore the value in force before that action.
MPE-OPS-013.verify: analysis using the Quint invariant I2 (o4), plus a devnet test with no ratification.

MPE-OPS-014.title: Exits survive a bus pause
MPE-OPS-014.sentence: Where the Bus Registry holds Publisher deposits, while the bus pause flag is set, the Bus Registry shall accept withdrawal and slashing calls.
MPE-OPS-014.verify: analysis using the Quint invariant I3, plus a devnet test with the bus paused.

MPE-OPS-015.title: No revocation by fiat
MPE-OPS-015.sentence: The Bus Registry shall provide no governance operation that revokes a Publisher admission credential without misuse evidence checked by the Bus Registry circuit.
MPE-OPS-015.verify: inspection of the Bus Registry entry points; analysis that every removal path checks evidence.

MPE-OPS-016.title: Maintenance notice
MPE-OPS-016.sentence: When a Bus Registry maintenance update is prepared, MPE shall publish its full content at least P-OPS-8 before submitting it.
MPE-OPS-016.verify: inspection. The publication time of the notice precedes the transaction's block time by P-OPS-8.

MPE-OPS-017.title: Measure maintenance constraints
MPE-OPS-017.sentence: MPE shall determine on a ledger-9 network, before Stage 2, whether a `ContractMaintenanceAuthority` can enforce a delay on verifier-key replacement.
MPE-OPS-017.verify: test on a devnet. Attempt a delayed maintenance update and record the outcome.

MPE-OPS-018.title: Public governance events
MPE-OPS-018.sentence: When the Bus Registry applies a parameter change, pause, emergency action or relay ejection, the Bus Registry shall emit one `mip-xxxx:governance[v1]` `Misc` event whose payload is an action byte, a 2-byte reason code and a 32-byte subject, zero-filled.
MPE-OPS-018.verify: test. Each action type on a devnet produces one matching `Misc` in the `contractEvents` output.

MPE-OPS-019.title: Steward diversity
MPE-OPS-019.sentence: Where a steward set governs the Bus Registry, MPE shall seat no more than P-OPS-9 stewards from any one organization.
MPE-OPS-019.verify: inspection of the steward roster at every steward-set change.

MPE-OPS-020.title: Governance end state
MPE-OPS-020.sentence: When the open-admission stage exit review starts, MPE shall show that the Bus Registry maintenance authority has been transferred to Midnight federated governance or removed.
MPE-OPS-020.verify: inspection, read the Bus Registry's maintenance authority from ledger state.

MPE-OPS-021.title: Overlay survives a chain pause
MPE-OPS-021.sentence: While the Midnight chain filters `send_mn_transaction`, the Bus Node shall continue relaying MPE Envelopes admitted under its last cached Bus Registry roots.
MPE-OPS-021.verify: test. With the mock Ledger Adapter frozen, admitted Envelopes keep reaching Subscribers.

MPE-OPS-022.title: Stale view gives Ignore
MPE-OPS-022.sentence: If the Bus Node's Bus Registry view lags the chain head by more than P-OPS-10, then the Bus Node shall return Ignore, not Reject, for MPE Envelopes whose admission check depends on that view.
MPE-OPS-022.verify: test. With a delayed mock adapter, the P₄ counters of honest peers stay at zero.

MPE-OPS-023.title: Ejection takes effect
MPE-OPS-023.sentence: When a relay is removed from the Bus Registry relay list, the Bus Node shall stop meshing with that relay within P-OPS-11.
MPE-OPS-023.verify: test. Remove a peer in the mock Bus Registry, then measure the time until no Prototype has it in any mesh.

MPE-OPS-024.title: Evidence-only ejection when open
MPE-OPS-024.sentence: While the relay allow-list is inactive, MPE shall eject a relay only on published evidence that P-OPS-16 independent monitors measured its canary delivery below P-OPS-5 for P-OPS-12, or on a malformed Anchor it signed.
MPE-OPS-024.verify: inspection, every ejection event references the monitor records and the threshold computation.

MPE-OPS-025.title: Tombstone deletion
MPE-OPS-025.sentence: Where a Bus Operator has signed the Bus Operator Agreement, when its Store Node receives a tombstone for an MPE Envelope identifier signed by the governance threshold, the Store Node shall delete that MPE Envelope within P-OPS-13.
MPE-OPS-025.verify: test. Canary tombstones; at least 99 % deleted within P-OPS-13 (o4 D10).

MPE-OPS-026.title: Tombstoned Envelope not relayed
MPE-OPS-026.sentence: Where tombstones are enabled, when the Bus Node holds a valid tombstone for an MPE Envelope Identifier, the Bus Node shall Ignore that MPE Envelope.
MPE-OPS-026.verify: test, a replayed tombstoned Envelope is not forwarded and the sender's P4 term is unchanged.

MPE-OPS-027.title: Transparency report
MPE-OPS-027.sentence: MPE shall publish, every P-OPS-14, a report of the counts of tombstones, ejections, emergency actions and slashes in that period.
MPE-OPS-027.verify: inspection. The report counts match the Bus Registry events for the period.

MPE-OPS-028.title: Abuse report on explicit action only
MPE-OPS-028.sentence: The MPE client library shall send an abuse report only on an explicit request by the receiving user.
MPE-OPS-028.verify: test. Paired clients with different interests emit identical traffic when no report is requested.

MPE-OPS-029.title: No IP persistence
MPE-OPS-029.sentence: The Bus Node shall not write peer IP addresses to persistent storage in its default configuration.
MPE-OPS-029.verify: test. After a 24 h Prototype run, a search of disk and logs finds no peer IP.

MPE-OPS-030.title: Debug logging expires
MPE-OPS-030.sentence: If debug logging is enabled on a Bus Node, then the Bus Node shall disable it after P-OPS-15.

MPE-OPS-031.title: Canary probes
MPE-OPS-031.sentence: MPE shall run canary Publishers in every Shard from at least P-OPS-16 monitor organizations, each publishing one MPE Envelope per P-OPS-17.
MPE-OPS-031.verify: inspection of the monitor roster; demonstration from canary logs.

MPE-OPS-032.title: Canaries look ordinary
MPE-OPS-032.sentence: The MPE client library shall send canary MPE Envelopes through the same size classes and admission path as other MPE Envelopes.
MPE-OPS-032.verify: analysis. A classifier trained on relay-visible fields does no better than chance at telling canaries from other Envelopes.

MPE-OPS-034.title: Multi-monitor decisions
MPE-OPS-034.sentence: MPE shall base each relay ejection or Bus Operator payout on measurements from at least P-OPS-16 independent monitors.
MPE-OPS-034.verify: inspection of each ejection and payout record.

MPE-OPS-035.title: Version overlap
MPE-OPS-035.sentence: When a new MPE Envelope version is activated, the Bus Node shall accept both the new and the previous version for at least P-OPS-19.
MPE-OPS-035.verify: test. A mixed-version Prototype mesh delivers both versions through the overlap period.

MPE-OPS-036.title: Version deny-list
MPE-OPS-036.sentence: When the Bus Node receives a version deny-list entry signed by the governance threshold, the Bus Node shall Ignore MPE Envelopes of that version.
MPE-OPS-036.verify: test. Envelopes of the denied version are dropped, and no peer's P₄ count changes.

MPE-OPS-037.title: Relay key handover
MPE-OPS-037.sentence: The Bus Node shall support replacing its identity key through a handover signed by the old key and recorded in the Bus Registry relay list.
MPE-OPS-037.verify: test on a devnet. After the handover the new key is grafted and the old key is not.

MPE-OPS-038.title: Signed reproducible releases
MPE-OPS-038.sentence: MPE shall publish each Bus Node release as a reproducible build signed by at least P-OPS-20 independent signers.
MPE-OPS-038.verify: test. Two independent rebuilds match the release hash bit for bit.

MPE-OPS-039.title: Sev1 mitigation time
MPE-OPS-039.sentence: When an incident is classified Sev1, MPE shall publish a signed release or configuration change that removes the classified trigger within P-OPS-21.
MPE-OPS-039.verify: demonstration, timed drills at least twice per year; the drill's trigger no longer reproduces on the published artifact.

MPE-OPS-040.title: Post-mortem
MPE-OPS-040.sentence: When a Sev1 or Sev2 incident is closed, MPE shall publish a post-mortem within P-OPS-27.
MPE-OPS-040.verify: inspection of the incident log against publication dates.

MPE-OPS-041.title: Pause drill
MPE-OPS-041.sentence: MPE shall complete a bus pause-to-resume drill within P-OPS-22 before exiting Stage 1.
MPE-OPS-041.verify: demonstration on the Stage 1 network, with timestamps from the Bus Registry events.

MPE-OPS-042.title: Gated stages
MPE-OPS-042.sentence: MPE shall not start a launch stage until every exit gate of the preceding stage has passed with published evidence.
MPE-OPS-042.verify: inspection of the gate record for each stage transition.

MPE-OPS-043.title: Evidence freeze
MPE-OPS-043.sentence: When the Stage 0 exit review starts, MPE shall record the target network's ledger version, runtime `spec_version` and the pinned revision of every Midnight component the bus depends on.
MPE-OPS-043.verify: inspection, compare the claim register against a live RPC `spec_version` query.

MPE-OPS-044.title: Ledger-generation gate
MPE-OPS-044.sentence: While the target network runs ledger 8, MPE shall make no production claim for a feature that needs ledger-9 contract events or cross-contract calls.
MPE-OPS-044.verify: inspection of the published feature claims against the network's ledger version; compilation confirms that the Bus Registry needs toolchain 0.33.0 or later only for `emit` and compiles with 0.31.1 without Anchors and governance events.

MPE-OPS-045.title: Prototype on a mock adapter
MPE-OPS-045.sentence: The Prototype shall run every Stage 0 test against a mock Ledger Adapter without a public Midnight network.
MPE-OPS-045.verify: demonstration. The full test suite passes offline.

MPE-OPS-046.title: Measured Bus Registry costs
MPE-OPS-046.sentence: When the Stage 1 exit review starts, MPE shall report the measured serialized bytes and DUST fee of one Bus Registry admission transaction and one Anchor transaction on a ledger-9 network.
MPE-OPS-046.verify: test, on a devnet with the recorded `ledgerParameters`; until then the report uses the measured model inputs (proofs of at most 4,368 bytes, verifying keys of at most 2,119 bytes, simulator transcript gas).

MPE-OPS-047.title: Scoring-CVE release gate
MPE-OPS-047.sentence: When a Bus Node release is prepared for a network other than a test network, MPE shall attach a recorded run showing the CVE-2022-47547 score-manipulation attack failing against that release's pinned GossipSub implementation and scoring configuration.
MPE-OPS-047.verify: test, run the attack scenario against the release candidate and check that the attacker's score falls below the graylist threshold.

MPE-OPS-048.title: Audit gate
MPE-OPS-048.sentence: MPE shall not deactivate the relay allow-list while an independent audit of the Bus Node parser, admission check or Bus Registry has an open critical or high finding.
MPE-OPS-048.verify: inspection of the audit report status.

MPE-OPS-049.title: Permissioned-stage exit
MPE-OPS-049.sentence: MPE shall not leave the permissioned-overlay stage until canary delivery has stayed at or above P-OPS-5 for P-OPS-23 consecutive days.

MPE-OPS-050.title: Counsel-memo gate
MPE-OPS-050.sentence: MPE shall not admit a Bus Operator in a jurisdiction without a counsel memo on the liability of relaying ciphertext in that jurisdiction.
MPE-OPS-050.verify: inspection. One memo on file for each roster jurisdiction.

MPE-OPS-051.title: Funding gate
MPE-OPS-051.sentence: MPE shall not leave the permissioned-overlay stage without written funding commitments covering every launch Bus Operator role for P-OPS-24.
MPE-OPS-051.verify: inspection of the signed commitments against the roster.

MPE-OPS-052.title: Anonymity-claim gate
MPE-OPS-052.sentence: MPE shall publish no broadcast anonymity-set claim while organic load is below P-OPS-25 or distinct active publisher admissions number fewer than P-OPS-26.
MPE-OPS-052.verify: inspection of published claims against aggregated load (MPE-OPS-033) and Bus Registry counts.

MPE-OPS-053.title: Course-change register
MPE-OPS-053.sentence: MPE shall maintain a register in which each course-change trigger has a measurable threshold and a named response.
MPE-OPS-053.verify: inspection. Every trigger has a numeric threshold and a response.

MPE-OPS-054.title: Launch sequencing
MPE-OPS-054.sentence: While no ledger-9 mainnet activation date precedes the Stage 1 start date, MPE shall run Stage 1 as a permissioned overlay whose Ledger Adapter targets a ledger-9 devnet.
MPE-OPS-054.verify: inspection of the Stage 1 deployment against the network's ledger version.

MPE-PRV-001.title: Claim register
MPE-PRV-001.sentence: The MPE shall maintain a claim register assigning each privacy claim its game, adversary classes, assumptions, permitted leakage, supporting evidence, verification procedure, and applicable profile.
MPE-PRV-001.verify: inspection, check every advertised claim against the required register fields.

MPE-PRV-002.title: Content confidentiality
MPE-PRV-002.sentence: The MPE shall provide computational indistinguishability in the Content Game against R, C, G, and A adversaries lacking challenge decryption secrets.
MPE-PRV-002.verify: analysis, review the selected construction's reduction and its implementation assumptions against the complete Content Game.

MPE-PRV-003.title: Sealed logical labels
MPE-PRV-003.sentence: The MPE shall exclude stream names, recipient addresses, and session or group identifiers from cleartext MPE Envelope fields.
MPE-PRV-003.verify: inspection, enumerate serialized fields and check representative data and control Envelopes for exposed logical labels.

MPE-PRV-004.title: Recipient-key-hiding claim gate
MPE-PRV-004.sentence: The MPE shall withhold a recipient-key-hiding claim until reviewed analysis establishes the selected wrapper's key privacy against adversaries knowing candidate recipient public keys.
MPE-PRV-004.verify: analysis, inspect the wrapper's key-privacy game, reduction, public fields, and recognition interfaces.

MPE-PRV-005.title: Length concealment within a class
MPE-PRV-005.sentence: The MPE shall give MPE Envelopes in the same configured size class identical serialized lengths regardless of their contained Message lengths.
MPE-PRV-005.verify: test, serialize boundary-length Messages within each supported class and compare complete Envelope lengths.

MPE-PRV-006.title: Conditional subscriber-interest privacy
MPE-PRV-006.sentence: While the Subscriber uses the private reception profile, the MPE client library shall satisfy the Selection Game within its received Shard set.
MPE-PRV-006.verify: test, compare paired executions with different interests under identical transport inputs and schedules.

MPE-PRV-007.title: Local recognition secrets
MPE-PRV-007.sentence: While the Subscriber uses the private reception profile, the MPE client library shall retain its Message decryption, stream, recognition, and wallet viewing secrets within the Subscriber's trusted endpoint boundary.
MPE-PRV-007.verify: inspection, trace secret-bearing values through outbound requests, provider APIs, configuration, and remote diagnostics.
MPE-PRV-007.note: This excludes, by design, the per-wallet relevance and session-decryption model that MPS-0005 plans for the Indexer.

MPE-PRV-008.title: No private selection predicates
MPE-PRV-008.sentence: While the Subscriber uses the private reception profile, the MPE client library shall omit stream, Recognition Tag, recipient, detection-key, and recognized-Envelope selectors from infrastructure requests.
MPE-PRV-008.verify: test, capture live and back-fill requests for Subscribers with different private interests and inspect all selectors.
MPE-PRV-008.note: This excludes, by design, the per-wallet relevance and session-decryption model that MPS-0005 plans for the Indexer.

MPE-PRV-009.title: Recognition-independent transport
MPE-PRV-009.sentence: While the Subscriber uses the private reception profile, the MPE client library shall make transport actions independent of local recognition outcomes.
MPE-PRV-009.verify: test, compare requests, cursors, sizes, retry decisions, repair selections, and transmission schedules after matched, unmatched, malformed, and replayed Envelopes.

MPE-PRV-010.title: No recognition acknowledgements
MPE-PRV-010.sentence: When an MPE Envelope is recognized, the MPE client library shall emit no automatic network acknowledgement of recognition.
MPE-PRV-010.verify: test, capture traffic after recognition and distinguish any publication or storage receipt from recipient recognition.

MPE-PRV-011.title: Explicit application reactions
MPE-PRV-011.sentence: When a Message is recognized, the MPE client library shall require explicit application authorization before initiating a Message-dependent external action.
MPE-PRV-011.verify: test, recognize Messages containing external-action instructions and confirm that recognition alone initiates no external action.

MPE-PRV-012.title: Overload preserves the privacy boundary
MPE-PRV-012.sentence: If whole-Shard reception exceeds a configured resource limit, then the MPE client library shall report reception failure without substituting interest-dependent retrieval.
MPE-PRV-012.verify: test, exhaust reception limits and inspect subsequent requests for introduced selection predicates.

MPE-PRV-013.title: Explicit privacy-changing fallback
MPE-PRV-013.sentence: If a fallback changes the applicable leakage contract, then the MPE client library shall block its activation until the application explicitly selects the changed profile.
MPE-PRV-013.verify: test, disable the primary path and confirm that a path with different leakage remains inactive without profile selection.

MPE-PRV-014.title: Recognition-free remote diagnostics
MPE-PRV-014.sentence: While the Subscriber uses the private reception profile, the MPE client library shall exclude private interest sets and recognition outcomes from remotely exported diagnostics.
MPE-PRV-014.verify: test, inspect exported diagnostics across paired interest sets, including malformed matched Messages and local errors.

MPE-PRV-015.title: Explicit plaintext disclosure
MPE-PRV-015.sentence: When an application requests disclosure of Message plaintext outside its authorized audience, the MPE client library shall require explicit application authorization for that disclosure.
MPE-PRV-015.verify: test, exercise ledger submission and reporting paths and confirm that recognition does not authorize plaintext export.

MPE-PRV-016.title: Bus Node leakage declaration
MPE-PRV-016.sentence: The MPE shall include L-R in every applicable privacy profile's leakage declaration.
MPE-PRV-016.verify: inspection, reconcile L-R with serialized fields and instrumented ingress, subscription, and forwarding observations.

MPE-PRV-017.title: Store Node leakage declaration
MPE-PRV-017.sentence: The MPE shall include L-S in every applicable privacy profile's leakage declaration.
MPE-PRV-017.verify: inspection, reconcile L-S with live, reconnect, back-fill, and repair request traces.

MPE-PRV-018.title: Admission issuer leakage declaration
MPE-PRV-018.sentence: Where admission issuance is present, the MPE shall include L-U in the applicable privacy profile's leakage declaration.
MPE-PRV-018.verify: inspection, inventory issuer inputs and linkable records for the selected admission mechanism.

MPE-PRV-019.title: Indexer leakage declaration
MPE-PRV-019.sentence: Where an Indexer read path is present, the MPE shall include L-X in the applicable privacy profile's leakage declaration.
MPE-PRV-019.verify: inspection, enumerate GraphQL arguments and supplied secrets for each enabled Indexer path.

MPE-PRV-020.title: Ledger leakage declaration
MPE-PRV-020.sentence: The MPE shall include L-L in every applicable privacy profile's leakage declaration.
MPE-PRV-020.verify: inspection, enumerate public fields of registration, admission, Anchor, ledger-lane, and consumption transactions.

MPE-PRV-021.title: Collusion leakage declaration
MPE-PRV-021.sentence: The MPE shall include L-C in every applicable privacy profile's leakage declaration.
MPE-PRV-021.verify: analysis, join issuer, ingress, retrieval, and ledger records and document available correlations.

MPE-PRV-022.title: Global-observer leakage declaration
MPE-PRV-022.sentence: The MPE shall include L-G in every applicable privacy profile's leakage declaration.
MPE-PRV-022.verify: inspection, compare the declaration with a simulated global observer's traffic and public-action records.

MPE-PRV-023.title: Insider leakage declaration
MPE-PRV-023.sentence: The MPE shall include L-I in every applicable privacy profile's leakage declaration.
MPE-PRV-023.verify: demonstration, show authorized recognition and plaintext export without treating either as a confidentiality violation.

MPE-PRV-024.title: Launch metadata non-claims
MPE-PRV-024.sentence: The MPE shall label publisher-message unlinkability, general recipient-message unlinkability, relationship privacy, timing privacy, volume privacy, and hidden participation as unclaimed by the launch profile.
MPE-PRV-024.verify: inspection, check profile descriptions, API privacy labels, demonstrations, and claim-register entries for these explicit exclusions.

MPE-PRV-025.title: No anonymity from unsigned transactions
MPE-PRV-025.sentence: The MPE shall describe the absence of a Substrate signer as a ledger-interface fact without presenting it as proof of publisher or payer unlinkability.
MPE-PRV-025.verify: inspection, check ledger privacy descriptions against L-L and their supporting code facts.

MPE-PRV-026.title: Launch compromise-security posture
MPE-PRV-026.sentence: The MPE shall label content forward secrecy, metadata forward secrecy, and post-compromise security as unclaimed by the launch bus profile.
MPE-PRV-026.verify: inspection, confirm that profile labels expose the consequences of later key compromise and retained historical keys.

MPE-PRV-027.title: No launch post-quantum claim
MPE-PRV-027.sentence: The MPE shall label post-quantum confidentiality as unclaimed by the launch profile.
MPE-PRV-027.verify: inspection, check claim-register exclusions against the selected payload and ledger cryptographic dependencies.

MPE-PRV-028.title: No adversarial archive-erasure claim
MPE-PRV-028.sentence: The MPE shall describe MPE Envelope expiry as an honest-service retention rule without claiming deletion from adversarial archives.
