MPE-PRV-028.verify: demonstration, retain a captured Envelope beyond expiry and verify that privacy documentation acknowledges the remaining copy.

MPE-PRV-029.title: No inherited stem anonymity
MPE-PRV-029.sentence: Where stem forwarding is present, the MPE shall label its source-attribution effect as an unproved heuristic unless analysis covers the implemented construction and adversary.
MPE-PRV-029.verify: inspection, check every stem claim against the actual routing graph, adversary, traffic policy, and cited theorem.

MPE-PRV-030.title: Evidence before advertising a property
MPE-PRV-030.sentence: When a privacy property is advertised as provided, the MPE shall supply reviewed evidence establishing that property's registered game for the implemented profile.
MPE-PRV-030.verify: analysis, audit the claim-to-construction mapping and reject evidence that omits an interface or adversary capability.

MPE-PRV-031.title: Paired selection verification
MPE-PRV-031.sentence: The Prototype shall produce a paired-execution report comparing complete infrastructure-observable transcripts for Subscribers with different private interests under identical Selection Game inputs.
MPE-PRV-031.verify: test, control clocks and randomness; compare request bytes, sizes, cursors, scheduling decisions, and exported diagnostics; report every difference.

MPE-PRV-032.title: Active selection verification
MPE-PRV-032.sentence: The Prototype shall exercise the Selection Game under selective omissions, replay, malformed matched traffic, reconnects, and queue pressure.
MPE-PRV-032.verify: test, require unchanged transport policy across paired interests for every enumerated attack; treat any recognition-dependent difference as failure.

MPE-PRV-033.title: Attribution measurements
MPE-PRV-033.sentence: The Prototype shall report source-attribution precision and recall for random and targeted adversary placements using P-PRV-1.
MPE-PRV-033.verify: simulation, record topology, actual node counts, controlled connections, bandwidth, Bus Operator concentration, admission share, estimator, and results for each placement.

MPE-PRV-034.title: Bound applicability
MPE-PRV-034.sentence: When literature supplies a quantitative privacy bound, the MPE shall document the mapping from that bound's assumptions and variables to the implemented profile before using it as an MPE guarantee.
MPE-PRV-034.verify: analysis, inspect model, graph, observation, traffic, and variable mappings; reject unsupported substitutions.

MPE-PRV-035.title: Violated-claim withdrawal
MPE-PRV-035.sentence: If verification demonstrates a violation of an advertised privacy game, then the MPE shall mark that profile's affected claim as unsupported.
MPE-PRV-035.verify: demonstration, introduce a known recognition leak and confirm that the affected claim fails the release evidence check.

MPE-PRV-036.title: Unknown leakage inventory
MPE-PRV-036.sentence: When a proposed interface has unresolved privacy-relevant fields, the Prototype shall produce an observation inventory from that interface before the associated profile is accepted.
MPE-PRV-036.verify: inspection, reconcile packet captures, API arguments, public ledger fields, and remote diagnostics with the profile's leakage declaration.

MPE-PRV-037.title: Separate stronger-profile evidence
MPE-PRV-037.sentence: Where a stronger privacy profile is present, the MPE shall maintain a separate claim register for its implemented composition.
MPE-PRV-037.verify: inspection, confirm that experimental results and component guarantees are confined to the separately analyzed profile.

MPE-SEC-001.title: Launch relay admission
MPE-SEC-001.sentence: While launch relay admission is permissioned, the Bus Node shall admit only relay identities authorized by its authenticated Bus Registry snapshot.
MPE-SEC-001.verify: test, attempt relay admission with authorized, unauthorized, revoked and substituted identities against a mock Ledger Adapter.

MPE-SEC-002.title: Bootstrap source diversity
MPE-SEC-002.sentence: When forming its initial peer set, the Bus Node shall use authenticated bootstrap records supplied by P-SEC-2 independent Bus Operators.
MPE-SEC-002.verify: test, poison one bootstrap source and confirm that unauthenticated records cannot replace the independently authenticated source.

MPE-SEC-003.title: Outbound connection protection
MPE-SEC-003.sentence: When maintaining a Shard mesh with sufficient eligible outbound peers, the Bus Node shall retain at least P-SEC-1 outbound mesh connections.
MPE-SEC-003.verify: simulation, saturate inbound connections and inspect mesh membership after grafting, oversubscription pruning and heartbeat maintenance.

MPE-SEC-004.title: Active peer scoring
MPE-SEC-004.sentence: The Bus Node shall apply the selected GossipSub scoring profile, the v1.1 scoring rules carried in the v1.2 profile, to mesh peer selection.
MPE-SEC-004.verify: test, drive peers across the selected pruning, graylisting and opportunistic-grafting thresholds and check the corresponding behaviour.

MPE-SEC-005.title: Admission before forwarding
MPE-SEC-005.sentence: The Bus Node shall forward an MPE Envelope's payload only after validating its Admission Proof against the authorized network, admission window, Shard, size class, expiry, proof-independent MPE Envelope Identifier and publication allowance.
MPE-SEC-005.verify: test, mutate each bound field independently and confirm no forwarding; inspect that application validation precedes GossipSub acceptance.

MPE-SEC-006.title: Cheap framing checks
MPE-SEC-006.sentence: If an MPE Envelope violates the supported framing rules, then the Bus Node shall discard it before admission cryptography or allocation based on its declared variable lengths.
MPE-SEC-006.verify: test, submit truncated records, excessive lengths, invalid size classes, noncanonical encodings and invalid reserved fields; instrument verifier calls and allocations.

MPE-SEC-007.title: Rejection of proven invalidity
MPE-SEC-007.sentence: If validation establishes that an MPE Envelope violates supported framing or cryptographic admission rules, then the Bus Node shall classify it as GossipSub Reject.
MPE-SEC-007.verify: test, inject a malformed supported Envelope and an invalid proof; confirm no forwarding and the configured P₄ score change.

MPE-SEC-008.title: Ignore local uncertainty
MPE-SEC-008.sentence: If validation cannot determine validity because of unavailable admission state, a stale chain view, a protocol context the Bus Node does not support or local overload, then the Bus Node shall classify the MPE Envelope as GossipSub Ignore.
MPE-SEC-008.verify: test, exercise each condition with valid traffic and confirm no forwarding and no P₄ increment; a malformed Envelope under a supported version is Rejected (MPE-FMT-023).

MPE-SEC-009.title: Verification backlog bounds
MPE-SEC-009.sentence: The Bus Node shall limit outstanding verification work to P-SEC-3 jobs per peer within a total of P-SEC-4 jobs.
MPE-SEC-009.verify: test, flood through existing and newly created connections and confirm both bounds include executing jobs.

MPE-SEC-010.title: Verification scheduling fairness
MPE-SEC-010.sentence: While multiple peer verification queues remain nonempty, the Bus Node shall dispatch jobs by round-robin peer selection.
MPE-SEC-010.verify: test, keep attacker queues saturated and confirm each continuously nonempty peer queue receives a dispatch opportunity in every scheduling round.

MPE-SEC-011.title: Retrieval abuse limits
MPE-SEC-011.sentence: If a retrieval request would exceed a configured retrieval byte, request or concurrency budget, then the Store Node shall refuse that request with ResourceExhausted.
MPE-SEC-011.verify: test, exceed each STO/PRF retrieval budget using oversized intervals, parallel requests and repeated requests; confirm refusal before excess resource commitment.

MPE-SEC-012.title: Storage exhaustion response
MPE-SEC-012.sentence: If accepting a retention request would exceed its configured storage cap, then the Store Node shall refuse that request with StorageExhausted.
MPE-SEC-012.verify: test, fill the configured cap with unexpired Envelopes and confirm refusal leaves existing unexpired bodies intact.

MPE-SEC-013.title: Historical admission separation
MPE-SEC-013.sentence: When serving retained MPE Envelopes through back-fill, the Store Node shall validate admission using the historical Bus Registry snapshot applicable to each MPE Envelope.
MPE-SEC-013.verify: test, retrieve an historically valid Envelope after its admission window closes and confirm historical validation consumes no new allowance.

MPE-SEC-014.title: Proof-independent deduplication
MPE-SEC-014.sentence: The Bus Node shall treat alternative valid Admission Proof serializations for the same proof-independent MPE Envelope identifier as duplicate publication.
MPE-SEC-014.verify: test, supply alternative valid proof representations for an identical authenticated Envelope representation and confirm only the initial publication is accepted.

MPE-SEC-015.title: Optional durable admission replay state
MPE-SEC-015.sentence: Where durable replay state is configured, the Bus Node shall commit each consumed publication allowance to durable storage before forwarding its MPE Envelope.
MPE-SEC-015.verify: test, interrupt at the persistence and forwarding boundaries, restart, and replay the admitted Envelope.

MPE-SEC-016.title: Missing replay-state recovery
MPE-SEC-016.sentence: If replay state for still-usable publication allowances is missing or cannot be validated after recovery, then the Bus Node shall refuse live admission under those allowances.
MPE-SEC-016.verify: test, restore absent, corrupt and detectably stale replay state and confirm affected admission remains unavailable until recovery establishes the required history or permanent expiry.

MPE-SEC-017.title: Replay-state pruning boundary
MPE-SEC-017.sentence: The Bus Node shall retain a consumed allowance record until every accepted authorization using that allowance is permanently ineligible for live publication.
MPE-SEC-017.verify: test, exercise admission window boundaries, accepted historical roots, clock tolerance and restart recovery; attempt reuse immediately before and after the pruning boundary.

MPE-SEC-018.title: Conflicting allowance use
MPE-SEC-018.sentence: If a valid MPE Envelope conflicts with an already consumed publication allowance, then the Bus Node shall classify that later MPE Envelope as GossipSub Ignore.
MPE-SEC-018.verify: simulation, spend an allowance on distinct signed Envelopes in separate partitions, reconnect, and confirm each node refuses subsequent conflicting acceptance without P₄ framing.

MPE-SEC-019.title: Conflict alarm
MPE-SEC-019.sentence: When it verifies conflicting MPE Envelopes authorized by the same publication allowance, the Bus Node shall emit an AdmissionConflict diagnostic containing their identifiers and the applicable authorization reference.
MPE-SEC-019.verify: test, distinguish valid equivocation from invalid proofs and confirm diagnostics use bounded records containing no plaintext or secret keys.

MPE-SEC-020.title: Authenticated key changes
MPE-SEC-020.sentence: If a discovery service presents a replacement for a pinned Publisher key without an authenticated change authorization, then the MPE client library shall reject that replacement.
MPE-SEC-020.verify: test, replace invitation and discovery keys through a hostile service and confirm the pinned identity remains authoritative.

MPE-SEC-021.title: Independent retrieval comparison
MPE-SEC-021.sentence: When completing a Shard retrieval interval, the MPE client library shall compare its MPE Envelope inventory against inventories supplied by P-SEC-2 independent Bus Operators.
MPE-SEC-021.verify: test, omit different Envelopes from different providers and confirm comparison covers the entire requested interval, including unrecognized Envelopes.

MPE-SEC-022.title: Authenticate Bus Registry read results
MPE-SEC-022.sentence: If an Indexer result is not confirmed by Bus Registry state read from P-NET-14 independent chain sources at a finalized block, then the Indexer adapter shall exclude it from admission, Anchor verification and `final` labelling.
MPE-SEC-022.verify: test, substitute contract addresses, invent Anchors, emit a `Misc` Anchor notification without matching Bus Registry state and alter Bus Registry data at one source; no authorization or `final` label derives from them.

MPE-SEC-023.title: Recognition-independent omission repair
MPE-SEC-023.sentence: When compared inventories differ, the MPE client library shall request repair of every missing MPE Envelope identifier in their union, subject to configured retrieval budgets.
MPE-SEC-023.verify: test, vary Subscriber keys over identical inventories and compare the requested repair identifiers; budget refusal must leave the interval unresolved.

MPE-SEC-024.title: Report unresolved retrieval
MPE-SEC-024.sentence: If inventory comparison is unavailable, an authenticated sequence gap remains or requested repair fails, then the MPE client library shall report the affected retrieval interval as Unresolved.
MPE-SEC-024.verify: test, remove a comparison source, withhold an interior sequence item and fail a repair request; confirm no complete-delivery assertion appears.

MPE-SEC-025.title: Recognition-independent network behavior
MPE-SEC-025.sentence: The MPE client library shall keep infrastructure-facing retrieval, retry, error and receipt behavior independent of whether an MPE Envelope’s Recognition Tag matches a Subscriber.
MPE-SEC-025.verify: test, replay identical feeds and failures with matching and nonmatching Subscriber keys; compare library-generated network transcripts before application actions.

MPE-SEC-026.title: Prevent silent privacy fallback
MPE-SEC-026.sentence: If recovery would change the selected privacy profile or replace whole-Shard retrieval with recognition-based filtering, then the MPE client library shall refuse the change until the caller explicitly selects that replacement profile.
MPE-SEC-026.verify: test, disable the selected transport or retrieval source and confirm no filtered or weaker-profile request precedes explicit caller selection.

MPE-SEC-027.title: Persistent logging limits
MPE-SEC-027.sentence: The Bus Node shall exclude client IP addresses, Recognition Tags and per-client activity histories from persistent logs.
MPE-SEC-027.verify: inspection, exercise normal operation, malformed traffic, admission conflicts and overload; inspect persisted application logs for prohibited fields.

MPE-SEC-028.title: Compromised-key send suspension
MPE-SEC-028.sentence: If a caller marks an active publishing or session key as compromised, then the MPE client library shall refuse publications using that key until authenticated replacement state is installed.
MPE-SEC-028.verify: test, mark each active key compromised, attempt publication, and confirm an unauthenticated service-supplied replacement cannot lift suspension.

MPE-SEC-029.title: Admission-key separation
MPE-SEC-029.sentence: The MPE client library shall use distinct secret keys for admission authorization, Message encryption and application identity authentication.
MPE-SEC-029.verify: inspection, trace key generation, derivation domains and API use; confirm no secret is reused across the named roles.

MPE-SEC-030.title: Authentication before session mutation
MPE-SEC-030.sentence: Where ratcheted sessions are present, the MPE client library shall commit received session-state changes only after message authentication succeeds.
MPE-SEC-030.verify: test, submit forged messages, malformed keys and replayed initialization inputs; compare persisted session state before and after failure.

MPE-SEC-031.title: Missing session-update response
MPE-SEC-031.sentence: Where ratcheted sessions are present, if authenticated session state identifies a required key update as missing, then the MPE client library shall refuse sensitive publications dependent on that update with SessionUpdateRequired.
MPE-SEC-031.verify: test, suppress required updates while delivering application traffic and confirm affected sends remain suspended until the authenticated update is applied.

MPE-SEC-032.title: Payload execution boundary
MPE-SEC-032.sentence: The MPE client library shall require explicit Consumer authorization before initiating any download or executing any command requested by Message payload data.
MPE-SEC-032.verify: test, deliver authenticated payloads containing executable expressions, command strings and external references; confirm decoding alone produces no corresponding side effect.

MPE-SEC-033.title: Unwanted-contact rejection
MPE-SEC-033.sentence: If an authenticated Publisher is denied by the Subscriber’s configured contact policy, then the MPE client library shall suppress delivery of that Publisher’s Message to the Consumer.
MPE-SEC-033.verify: test, apply allow and deny policies to authenticated Messages and confirm denied Messages cause no Consumer callback or recognition-dependent infrastructure response.

MPE-SEC-034.title: Authenticated tombstone deletion
MPE-SEC-034.sentence: Where authenticated tombstones are enabled, the Store Node shall delete the named MPE Envelope body within P-SEC-5 of successful tombstone authorization.
MPE-SEC-034.verify: test, authorize a tombstone using the OPS policy and confirm timely body deletion preserves admission replay records; forged tombstones must authorize no deletion.

MPE-SEC-035.title: Delivery during ledger interruption
MPE-SEC-035.sentence: While ledger-dependent registration or anchoring is unavailable, the Bus Node shall continue forwarding MPE Envelopes valid under still-eligible authenticated cached Bus Registry state.
MPE-SEC-035.verify: demonstration, disable the Ledger Adapter during active traffic; confirm eligible cached authorizations continue and expired or unknown authorizations do not.

MPE-SEC-036.title: Ledger-dependent failure reporting
MPE-SEC-036.sentence: If a ledger interruption or observed pause prevents registration, anchoring or contract consumption, then the MPE client library shall return a typed LedgerUnavailable or BusPaused outcome for the affected operation.
MPE-SEC-036.verify: test, separately fail each ledger-dependent operation and distinguish unavailable transport from an authenticated pause indication.

MPE-SEC-037.title: Contract authorization predicate
MPE-SEC-037.sentence: MPE shall permit a Message-triggered effect through its supplied contract-consumption integration only after in-circuit verification of an authorized Publisher’s signature binding the network genesis, target contract, action, payload commitment, logical message identifier and expiry.
MPE-SEC-037.verify: test, alter every bound field, substitute an unauthorized signer, omit signature assertions and use forged Indexer output; require zero unauthorized effects.

MPE-SEC-038.title: Atomic contract replay protection
MPE-SEC-038.sentence: MPE shall consume an authenticated logical Message’s replay identifier in the same atomic transaction as its supplied contract-consumption integration’s corresponding effect.
MPE-SEC-038.verify: test, repeat consumption through distinct transactions and Envelope wrappers, including failure boundaries; require at most one committed effect for each authenticated Message, target and action.

MPE-SEC-039.title: Configuration-specific attack evidence
MPE-SEC-039.sentence: The Prototype shall produce an attack report for every SEC test-matrix case, recording configuration, attacker placement, controlled resources, delivery ratio, latency percentiles, eclipse duration, peak resource use and unauthorized or duplicate effects.
MPE-SEC-039.verify: inspection, check that every matrix case has reproducible inputs and measured results; absent measurements must be recorded as unknown.

MPE-SEC-040.title: Scoring vulnerability release gate
MPE-SEC-040.sentence: The Prototype shall report public-overlay release as blocked until its pinned GossipSub implementation has a documented resolution of CVE-2022-47547 for the selected scoring configuration.
MPE-SEC-040.verify: inspection, review implementation provenance and applicability analysis, then run the corresponding attack regression against the pinned implementation and configuration.

MPE-VER-001.title: Reproducible acceptance profile
MPE-VER-001.sentence: The Prototype shall attach a reproducible acceptance profile to every acceptance run.
MPE-VER-001.verify: inspection, check source revisions, dependency lock, build flags, hardware, topology, transport, mesh/scoring configuration, workload, parameter values, random seeds, clock policy, commands and fixture hashes.

MPE-VER-002.title: Claim register
MPE-VER-002.sentence: MPE shall maintain an evidence record for each advertised privacy or capacity claim.
MPE-VER-002.verify: inspection, require claim wording, source revision, deployment generation, checked scope, assumptions, contradictory evidence, reproduction procedure and applicable acceptance results.

MPE-VER-003.title: Failed stage gate
MPE-VER-003.sentence: If a mandatory stage check fails or lacks evidence, then the Prototype shall mark that stage gate as failed.
MPE-VER-003.verify: test, inject failed, skipped, missing and timed-out mandatory checks; confirm none produces a passing gate.

MPE-VER-004.title: Wire conformance
MPE-VER-004.sentence: The Prototype shall pass the frozen MPE Envelope conformance suite before multi-node acceptance.
MPE-VER-004.verify: test, compare exact expected outcomes for valid vectors, incorrect lengths, unsupported versions, non-canonical encodings, malformed fields and applicable padding violations; include cross-implementation vectors supplied by FMT and CRY.

MPE-VER-005.title: Decoder fuzzing
MPE-VER-005.sentence: The Prototype shall complete P-VER-14 fuzz iterations without a crash in the MPE Envelope and application-payload decoders.
MPE-VER-005.verify: test, retain campaign configuration, iteration counts, sanitizer results and regression corpus; count only executions reaching a decoder, with coverage reported separately.

MPE-VER-006.title: Actual cryptographic costs
MPE-VER-006.sentence: The Prototype shall report measured wire size and execution-time distributions for every cryptographic operation on its selected publication path.
MPE-VER-006.verify: test, benchmark sealing, recognition, Admission Proof generation and validation on named reference hardware; include serialization, caching conditions, batch sizes, p50, p95, p99 and sample counts.

MPE-VER-007.title: Admission model
MPE-VER-007.sentence: The Prototype shall pass bounded exploration of the selected admission state machine without a violation of its frozen safety invariants.
MPE-VER-007.verify: analysis, explore allowance boundaries, root replacement, expiry, revocation, restart, rollback and conflicting bodies; check message binding, scoped replay rules and absence of allowance resets.

MPE-VER-008.title: Delivery-state model
MPE-VER-008.sentence: The Prototype shall pass bounded exploration of the client delivery state machine without a violation of its frozen cursor and deduplication invariants.
MPE-VER-008.verify: analysis, explore inclusive cursors, crash points, reconnect, failover, withheld suffixes and gap closure; check that committed progress never skips an undelivered recoverable Message.

MPE-VER-009.title: Contract-consumption model
MPE-VER-009.sentence: The Prototype shall pass bounded exploration of the contract-consumption model without an unauthorized or duplicate contract effect.
MPE-VER-009.verify: analysis, explore incorrect leaves, destinations, networks, expiry, missing Anchors, replay-state pruning and concurrent consumption; model the CON authorization predicate explicitly.

MPE-VER-010.title: Governance model gate
MPE-VER-010.sentence: Where Bus Registry governance features are present, MPE shall pass bounded exploration of their frozen governance invariants before production acceptance.
MPE-VER-010.verify: analysis, check applicable delayed changes, emergency expiry, threshold transitions, pause states, Anchor takeover and fund-conservation rules; record disabled features explicitly.

MPE-VER-011.title: Local multi-node demonstration
MPE-VER-011.sentence: The Prototype shall demonstrate Publisher-to-Subscriber Message delivery through P-VER-1 separate local Bus Node processes using rust-libp2p GossipSub under the v1.2 profile.
MPE-VER-011.verify: demonstration, publish every selected Envelope class across tested Shards; confirm matching Subscribers recover exact Messages and nonmatching Subscribers produce no false opens; use a declared mock Ledger Adapter.

MPE-VER-012.title: Nominal soak
MPE-VER-012.sentence: The Prototype shall complete a nominal acceptance run at P-VER-2 for P-VER-3 without an unplanned process termination.
MPE-VER-012.verify: test, use the local multi-node topology, real elapsed time and frozen Envelope mix; report offered, admitted and rejected rates separately.

MPE-VER-013.title: Nominal latency
MPE-VER-013.sentence: While the nominal acceptance workload is running, the Prototype shall achieve a post-admission delivery p99 no greater than P-VER-6.
MPE-VER-013.verify: test, measure first valid delivery for each expected Subscriber; publish the completion percentile and missing-delivery count under the measurement convention below.

MPE-VER-014.title: Nominal delivery fraction
MPE-VER-014.sentence: While the nominal acceptance workload is running, the Prototype shall deliver at least P-VER-7 of eligible MPE Envelope–Subscriber pairs within P-VER-6 after admission.
MPE-VER-014.verify: test, derive the denominator from generated accepted Envelopes and scheduled honest Subscribers; count each pair once, including pairs that never complete.

MPE-VER-015.title: Resource acceptance
MPE-VER-015.sentence: If a measured resource exceeds its frozen PRF or STO acceptance ceiling, then the Prototype shall fail resource acceptance.
MPE-VER-015.verify: test, check CPU, memory, ingress, egress, queue/cache occupancy, retained bytes, storage amplification and recognition cost against declared ceilings; an undefined ceiling yields an incomplete gate.

MPE-VER-016.title: Measurement report
MPE-VER-016.sentence: When an acceptance run ends, the Prototype shall produce a measurement report using the measurement convention below.
MPE-VER-016.verify: inspection, check latency distributions, admission outcomes, delivery coverage, transport amplification, resource time series, recovery results and raw artifact references.

MPE-VER-017.title: Scale simulations
MPE-VER-017.sentence: The Prototype shall produce scale-evaluation results at every Bus Node count in P-VER-8.
MPE-VER-017.verify: simulation, exercise nominal load, P-VER-9 for P-VER-10, bursts, cold starts and overload; incorporate measured validation delay and the NET topology; disclose simulator limitations and compare overlapping cases with the real binary.

MPE-VER-018.title: Adversarial dissemination gate
MPE-VER-018.sentence: While a non-partitioned adversarial acceptance run is active, the Prototype shall achieve a timely honest delivery fraction of at least P-VER-25 within P-VER-6.
MPE-VER-018.verify: simulation, use P-VER-11 shares at each P-VER-8 size; test targeted outbound placement, poisoned discovery, Sybil-heavy joining, selective dropping, concentrated bandwidth and synchronized Publishers; report every case separately.

MPE-VER-019.title: Admission abuse gate
MPE-VER-019.sentence: The Prototype shall accept zero publications violating the selected admission policy during an attack using P-VER-16 admission identities.
MPE-VER-019.verify: test, submit over-quota, forged, expired, wrong-network, revoked and conflicting-body publications across admission window boundaries and restarts; account for valid aggregate allowances separately.

MPE-VER-020.title: Validation outcome conformance
MPE-VER-020.sentence: The Prototype shall pass the validation outcome suite for the frozen Accept, Reject and Ignore policy.
MPE-VER-020.verify: test, compare forwarding and score effects with the selected policy; include validation timeout and cache eviction; verify application validation is enabled because the inspected configuration defaults to automatic forwarding.

MPE-VER-021.title: Invalid-ingress bounds
MPE-VER-021.sentence: While invalid-ingress saturation is active, the Prototype shall keep each queue and cache within its declared capacity.
MPE-VER-021.verify: test, saturate malformed frames, invalid Admission Proofs, repeated identifiers and control traffic; sample capacities and memory through overload and recovery; report verification CPU separately.

MPE-VER-022.title: Burst recovery
MPE-VER-022.sentence: When a P-VER-4 burst lasting P-VER-5 ends, the Prototype shall restore every monitored queue to its pre-burst nominal bound within P-VER-15.
MPE-VER-022.verify: test, establish bounds during a stable nominal interval before the burst; continue nominal load afterward and measure the first sustained return within those bounds.

MPE-VER-023.title: Recovery completeness
MPE-VER-023.sentence: The Prototype shall recover every eligible Message in the P-VER-13 recovery chaos workload.
MPE-VER-023.verify: test, inject client crashes, Bus Node and Store Node restarts, partitions and Indexer failover where present; compare the recovered Message set after recovery with the authoritative fixture set.

MPE-VER-024.title: Atomic consumer deduplication
MPE-VER-024.sentence: Where an atomic effect store is present, the Prototype shall produce at most one committed handler effect per Message in the recovery chaos workload.
MPE-VER-024.verify: test, crash between receive, effect commit and cursor commit; inject replay through overlay, back-fill and the ledger lane; count committed effects independently of callback attempts.

MPE-VER-025.title: Store failure recovery
MPE-VER-025.sentence: When one Store Node fails while another honest holder remains reachable, the Prototype shall recover all requested eligible MPE Envelopes within the selected retention window.
MPE-VER-025.verify: test, fail the initially selected Store Node, back-fill from another holder and compare identifiers and bytes; repeat near expiry and report unavailable expired ranges.

MPE-VER-026.title: Scoring attack regression
MPE-VER-026.sentence: The Prototype shall fail network acceptance if the selected GossipSub scoring configuration reproduces a registered scoring safety violation.
MPE-VER-026.verify: test, register the relevant CVE-2022-47547 attack traces and MPE-specific score counterexamples; exercise multi-Shard reward/penalty interactions, targeted dropping and the NET outbound-quota policy.

MPE-VER-027.title: First-spy measurement
MPE-VER-027.sentence: The Prototype shall report first-spy precision and recall for every coalition share in P-VER-12.
MPE-VER-027.verify: simulation, compare direct publication with any selected ingress mechanism on identical workloads; report topology, placement, load, estimator, sample counts and uncertainty, including idle and targeted cases.

MPE-VER-028.title: Interest-swapped executions
MPE-VER-028.sentence: The Prototype shall produce identical infrastructure-visible retrieval traces for paired executions differing only in Subscriber interests under identical connection and retrieval schedules.
MPE-VER-028.verify: test, compare requests, cursors, requested ranges, volumes and scheduled timing; include malformed matching Envelopes, withheld suffixes, reconnect, repair, acknowledgements and backpressure.

MPE-VER-029.title: Infrastructure log audit
MPE-VER-029.sentence: The Prototype shall pass a log audit with zero occurrences of fixture Message plaintext in Bus Node or Store Node logs.
MPE-VER-029.verify: test, publish unique plaintext canaries, trigger parsing, validation and storage errors, then scan logs and diagnostic exports; CRY and PRV separately define secret-field exclusions.

MPE-VER-030.title: Ledger integration measurements
MPE-VER-030.sentence: The Prototype shall report measured transaction costs and timing for each selected ledger operation on the integration test network.
MPE-VER-030.verify: test, record serialized bytes, applicable cost dimensions, live ledger parameters, DUST charge, proving, submission, inclusion, finality and indexing times; distinguish registration, Anchor and consumption operations; until devnet figures exist, use the measured model inputs (proofs of at most 4,368 bytes, verifying keys of at most 2,119 bytes, simulator transcript gas).

MPE-VER-031.title: Concurrent Anchor validity
MPE-VER-031.sentence: The Prototype shall demonstrate that a reaction whose inclusion path ends at an eligible Anchor root is still accepted despite intervening Anchor insertions.
MPE-VER-031.verify: test, prepare a reaction proof against an eligible root, insert later Anchors, then submit the original proof within the CON acceptance window; separately reject roots outside that window; the test shows root eligibility only, not that the anchored Envelope is the signed one.

MPE-VER-032.title: Contract reaction race
MPE-VER-032.sentence: The Prototype shall demonstrate exactly one authorized contract effect when P-VER-17 concurrent reactors submit valid consumption transactions for the same Message.
MPE-VER-032.verify: demonstration, under a functioning integration ledger with an eligible Anchor, include the racing transactions and inspect finalized contract state independently.

MPE-VER-033.title: Hostile ledger inputs
MPE-VER-033.sentence: The Prototype shall produce zero unauthorized contract effects in the hostile ledger-input suite.
MPE-VER-033.verify: test, inject fabricated Indexer results, incorrect Merkle leaves, misbound authorization, wrong destinations, expired statements, replays and failed fallible execution; inspect finalized effects and public disclosures.

MPE-VER-034.title: Deployment capability gate
MPE-VER-034.sentence: If the target network lacks a demonstrated capability required by the selected integration profile, then MPE shall fail production integration acceptance.
MPE-VER-034.verify: demonstration, execute the exact selected Bus Registry, Anchor and consumer operations against the target runtime and Indexer schema; require finalized results and generation evidence.

MPE-VER-035.title: Ledger Adapter failure
MPE-VER-035.sentence: When the Ledger Adapter is unavailable or returns stale state, the Prototype shall produce the NET-defined degraded-mode result for the affected operation.
MPE-VER-035.verify: test, disconnect the adapter, withhold finality, return old membership roots and delay Anchor reads; check result labels against NET and CON, then exercise recovery.

MPE-VER-036.title: Outside-developer usability
MPE-VER-036.sentence: The Prototype shall enable at least P-VER-19 of P-VER-18 outside developers to complete the publisher and crash-resuming subscriber exercise within P-VER-20.
MPE-VER-036.verify: demonstration, provide only released documentation, examples and a prepared local environment; count success only after publication, crash, resume and correct Message recovery without team coaching.

MPE-VER-037.title: Independent review gate
MPE-VER-037.sentence: MPE shall enter production acceptance only with zero unresolved critical or high-severity findings from independent review of the selected construction.
MPE-VER-037.verify: inspection, review admission binding, cryptography, encodings, parsing, persistent state, ledger-interface authorization and privacy claims; require reproducible closure evidence for each blocking finding.

MPE-VER-038.title: Production canary gate
MPE-VER-038.sentence: While the production pilot runs for P-VER-21, MPE shall achieve canary timely delivery of at least P-VER-22 within P-VER-23.
MPE-VER-038.verify: test, derive expected deliveries from scheduled accepted canaries; retain failures, outages, Bus Operator distribution and per-day results throughout the consecutive window.

MPE-VER-039.title: Pause and resume drill
MPE-VER-039.sentence: Where the selected Bus Registry profile supports pause, MPE shall complete the pause-to-resume acceptance drill within P-VER-24.
MPE-VER-039.verify: demonstration, exercise OPS runbooks and defined availability labels; test Bus Registry pause separately from ledger safe mode, without assuming MPE can resume the underlying ledger.

MPE-VER-040.title: Open admission gate
MPE-VER-040.sentence: If the open-admission red team reduces canary delivery below P-OPS-5, then MPE shall fail open-admission acceptance.
MPE-VER-040.verify: simulation, attackers hold as many peer identities as the honest set; targeted capture and cold joining.

MPE-FMT-001a.title: Fixed-width visible layout
MPE-FMT-001a.sentence: The MPE client library shall encode every MPE Envelope field outside the Sealed Body as a fixed-width field at a fixed per-version offset.
MPE-FMT-001a.verify: test, decode and re-encode every MPE-FMT-049 vector and compare the bytes for equality.

MPE-FMT-001b.title: No variable encodings outside the Sealed Body
MPE-FMT-001b.sentence: The MPE client library shall emit no optional field, extension field, length prefix, variable-length integer or self-describing encoding outside the Sealed Body.
MPE-FMT-001b.verify: inspection, review the wire specification; test, every fuzzed Envelope that carries such a construct fails MPE-FMT-006 or MPE-FMT-007.

MPE-OPS-033a.title: Aggregated counter release
MPE-OPS-033a.sentence: Where Bus Node counters are published, the Bus Node shall release them only as aggregates computed across at least P-OPS-16 share keepers, none of which receives an individual Bus Node's counter value.
MPE-OPS-033a.verify: inspection, review the counter-export path; test, capture share-keeper inputs and confirm each is a blinded share.

MPE-OPS-033b.title: Differential-privacy budget for counters
MPE-OPS-033b.sentence: Where Bus Node counters are published, the Bus Node shall add noise that gives each published counter a differential-privacy epsilon of at most P-OPS-18.
MPE-OPS-033b.verify: analysis, compute epsilon from the configured noise distribution and sensitivity; test, the noise sampler matches that distribution (KS test, p > 0.01).

MPE-CON-005a.title: Typed degraded outcome
MPE-CON-005a.sentence: If the active reception mode cannot be sustained, then the MPE client library shall return the typed `Degraded` outcome to the subscription.
MPE-CON-005a.verify: test, make every source unreachable and assert one `Degraded` outcome.

MPE-CON-005b.title: Reception mode unchanged after degradation
MPE-CON-005b.sentence: If the active reception mode cannot be sustained, then the MPE client library shall keep the reception mode unchanged until the application selects another profile.
MPE-CON-005b.verify: test, after `Degraded`, capture requests and confirm no selector or filtered request precedes an explicit profile selection.

MPE-CON-025a.title: Typed source failure
MPE-CON-025a.sentence: If a source connection fails, then the MPE client library shall return the typed `SourceFailed` outcome to the subscription.
MPE-CON-025a.verify: test, kill the source mid-stream and assert one `SourceFailed` outcome.

MPE-CON-025b.title: No completion on source failure
MPE-CON-025b.sentence: If a source connection fails, then the MPE client library shall keep the subscription open instead of ending it as complete.
MPE-CON-025b.verify: test, kill the source mid-stream and assert the subscription never emits completion.

MPE-CON-044a.title: Replayed consumption rejected
MPE-CON-044a.sentence: If a reaction's consumption nullifier is already in the target contract's consumption nullifier set, then the MPE client library's consumption circuit shall reject the reaction.
MPE-CON-044a.verify: test, submit the same reaction twice and assert the second transaction fails.

MPE-CON-044b.title: Atomic consumption nullifier insertion
MPE-CON-044b.sentence: The MPE client library's consumption circuit shall insert the consumption nullifier in the same transaction as the contract effect it authorizes.
MPE-CON-044b.verify: test, inject failure in the fallible segment and confirm neither the effect nor the consumption nullifier is committed.

MPE-NET-001a.title: Sidecar process
MPE-NET-001a.sentence: The Bus Node shall run as an operating-system process separate from `midnight-node`.
MPE-NET-001a.verify: inspection, the Prototype is its own binary and runs beside an unmodified node.

MPE-NET-001b.title: No MPE code in the node binary
MPE-NET-001b.sentence: MPE shall add no code to the `midnight-node` binary.
MPE-NET-001b.verify: inspection, the `midnight-node` dependency tree is unchanged by the MPE build.

MPE-NET-009a.title: StrictNoSign publication
MPE-NET-009a.sentence: The Bus Node shall publish every MPE Envelope under the GossipSub StrictNoSign policy, with the `from`, `seqno`, `signature` and `key` fields absent.
MPE-NET-009a.verify: test, captured RPC frames lack all four fields.

MPE-NET-009b.title: Signed-field rejection
MPE-NET-009b.sentence: If a received GossipSub message carries a `from`, `seqno`, `signature` or `key` protobuf field, including an explicitly empty one, then the Bus Node shall drop it and apply the invalid-message penalty to the forwarding peer.
MPE-NET-009b.verify: test, an injected message carrying any one of the four fields, present or empty, is not delivered and the forwarding peer's P4 score falls; inspection, the pinned decoder enforces the `key` check, which the vendored gossipsub 0.50.0 decoder lacks and the 0.51.0 source adds.

MPE-NET-043a.title: Complete-stream gateway
MPE-NET-043a.sentence: Where the gateway fallback is enabled, the Bus Node shall serve the complete MPE Envelope stream of a requested Shard in overlay framing.
MPE-NET-043a.verify: test, the byte streams from the overlay and from the gateway match for one Shard over 1 h.

MPE-NET-043b.title: No filter on the gateway
MPE-NET-043b.sentence: Where the gateway fallback is enabled, if a stream request carries a filter on streams, Recognition Tags or identifiers, then the Bus Node shall refuse the request with `Refused`.
MPE-NET-043b.verify: test, each filter parameter is refused and no Envelope is sent.

MPE-FMT-050.title: Admission Slot zero fill
MPE-FMT-050.sentence: If any Admission Slot byte after the selected proof fields is non-zero, then the Bus Node shall return Reject.
MPE-FMT-050.verify: test, set each filler byte of a valid vector in turn; each result is Reject.

MPE-FMT-051.title: Sealed Body clear prefix
MPE-FMT-051.sentence: The MPE client library shall place the P-CRY-3-byte salt, the 12-byte AEAD nonce and the P-CRY-2-byte Recognition Tag, in that order, at the start of the Sealed Body before the ciphertext.
MPE-FMT-051.verify: test vectors; a body copied from the mock ledger carrier opens exactly as its overlay copy.

MPE-FMT-052.title: Shard field matches GossipSub topic
MPE-FMT-052.sentence: If a received MPE Envelope's `shard` value differs from the Shard index of the GossipSub topic it arrived on, then the Bus Node shall return Reject.
MPE-FMT-052.verify: test, an Envelope with `shard` = 1 published on the Shard-0 GossipSub topic is Rejected and lowers the sender's P4 score.

MPE-FMT-053.title: One cryptographic profile per version and suite
MPE-FMT-053.sentence: The MPE client library shall bind each MPE Envelope version to exactly one cryptographic profile, identified by the `version` value; the profile's one-byte suite identifier names it in invitations and in the label table and is not a wire field.
MPE-FMT-053.verify: inspection, the profile table maps each `version` to one suite and profile, and a new suite takes a new version; test, an Envelope opened under another profile fails authentication.

MPE-CRY-041.title: Publisher authentication block
MPE-CRY-041.sentence: The MPE client library shall encode the sealed publisher authentication block as a 2-byte authorized-key index, a 4-byte creation time and the suite's publisher signature, 64 bytes for Ed25519.
MPE-CRY-041.verify: test vectors; for suite 0x01 the payload capacity per class equals body minus 170 B; any other suite states its signature length and recomputes capacity under MPE-CRY-036.

MPE-ECO-051.title: Stale-root bound
MPE-ECO-051.sentence: If the membership period served by an Admission Proof's referenced root ended more than P-ECO-5 before the Bus Node's clock, then the Bus Node shall return Ignore for that MPE Envelope.
MPE-ECO-051.verify: test, freeze the mock adapter and confirm Envelopes under the last root are Ignored 25 h after its period began.

MPE-ECO-052.title: Admission Slot field layout
MPE-ECO-052.sentence: The MPE client library shall fill the Admission Slot with the 8-byte admission window number, the 32-byte referenced membership root, the 32-byte admission nullifier, the 32-byte share y-coordinate and the proof, in that order.
MPE-ECO-052.verify: test vectors; a Bus Node rejects a stale admission window without invoking the verifier.

MPE-ECO-053.title: Admission window number
MPE-ECO-053.sentence: The MPE client library shall compute the admission window number as the Unix time in seconds divided by P-ECO-1, rounded down.

MPE-SEC-041.title: Seen-set entry after Accept
MPE-SEC-041.sentence: The Bus Node shall insert an MPE Envelope Identifier into its application seen-set only after its validator returns Accept for an MPE Envelope carrying that identifier.
MPE-SEC-041.verify: test, a Rejected corrupted-slot copy followed by the valid copy: the valid copy is accepted.

MPE-SEC-042.title: Corrupted-slot front-running test
MPE-SEC-042.sentence: The Prototype shall deliver an honest MPE Envelope to every eligible Subscriber within P-VER-6 when an adversarial peer injects copies of its Sealed Body with corrupted Admission Slots ahead of it.
MPE-SEC-042.verify: test, on the 32-node topology with the adversary adjacent to the publisher's ingress Bus Node.

MPE-STO-041.title: Inventory listing
MPE-STO-041.sentence: When a client requests an inventory for a Shard and time window, the Store Node shall return every retained MPE Envelope Identifier in that window in pages of at most P-PUB-9 entries.
MPE-STO-041.verify: test, a seeded store of N identifiers returns exactly N across pages.

MPE-STO-042.title: Retention receipt request
MPE-STO-042.sentence: When a client requests the retention receipts of a Shard window, the Store Node shall return a receipt for every MPE Envelope Identifier it retains in that window, each signed with its Bus Operator key over the identifier, the Shard and the retention deadline.
MPE-STO-042.verify: test, request receipts from three Store Nodes and validate them under MPE-STO-012.

MPE-NET-048.title: Shard stream service
MPE-NET-048.sentence: The Bus Node shall provide a stream protocol that sends a connected non-mesh client every MPE Envelope the Bus Node accepts on each Shard the client requests.
MPE-NET-048.verify: test, a client streaming one Shard receives every accepted identifier over 1 h; inspection, the service is an MPE request-response protocol, not a GossipSub subscription.

MPE-NET-049.title: Publish acceptance reply
MPE-NET-049.sentence: When the Bus Node has committed application acceptance of a client-submitted MPE Envelope and queued it for sending, the Bus Node shall send that client an `Accepted` reply carrying the MPE Envelope Identifier.
MPE-NET-049.verify: test, a client receives `Accepted` for accepted and queued Envelopes, `PublishFailed` when the publish call fails, `Busy` for transient local unavailability and `Refused` for every other refusal, including Envelopes the Bus Node Rejects or Ignores; inspection, these are MPE service replies, not GossipSub validator outcomes.

MPE-NET-050.title: Anchor payload
MPE-NET-050.sentence: Where a Bus Node acts as anchorer, the Bus Node shall encode each Anchor payload as an 8-byte big-endian window number, the 32-byte window root, eight 4-byte big-endian MPE Envelope counts and zero fill to 256 bytes.
MPE-NET-050.verify: test vectors: field offsets and payload length do not depend on the Shard count (counts of unused Shards are zero); a mock Bus Registry decodes every field.

MPE-NET-051.title: Batch root construction
MPE-NET-051.sentence: Where a Bus Node acts as anchorer, the Bus Node shall compute each per-Shard batch root as a SHA-256 Merkle root over the window's accepted MPE Envelope Identifiers in ascending byte order.
MPE-NET-051.verify: test vectors; an independent implementation reproduces the roots.

MPE-NET-052.title: Inclusion path service
MPE-NET-052.sentence: Where a Bus Node acts as anchorer, the Bus Node shall return, on request, the Merkle inclusion path of an anchored MPE Envelope Identifier for P-STO-9 after anchoring.
MPE-NET-052.verify: test, paths verify against the Anchor root; a path for a non-anchored identifier is refused.

MPE-NET-053.title: Anchorer authorization
MPE-NET-053.sentence: The Bus Registry shall accept an Anchor only from a caller that proves, in circuit, knowledge of the preimage of the anchorer key commitment stored in a relay entry with the anchorer role.
MPE-NET-053.verify: test, an Anchor from an unlisted relay or without the preimage fails on a devnet and on the mock Bus Registry.

MPE-NET-054.title: Relay list entries
MPE-NET-054.sentence: The Bus Registry shall expose a relay list keyed by SHA-256 of each relay's serialized libp2p PeerId, whose entries carry a Bus Operator organization identifier, role flags for relay, Store Node, bootstrapper, gateway and anchorer, and an anchorer key commitment.
MPE-NET-054.verify: inspection of the contract; test, the adapter reads every field and recomputes each key from the relay's PeerId, never treating a 32-byte value as a serialized PeerId.

MPE-NET-055.title: Ledger Adapter read set
MPE-NET-055.sentence: The Ledger Adapter shall expose finalized reads of membership roots with publication and supersession times taken from including block timestamps, the relay list, Bus Registry parameters, Anchors, the bus pause flag and the current `ledgerParameters`.
MPE-NET-055.verify: test, the mock adapter answers each read and the full Prototype suite passes against it.

MPE-NET-056.title: Historic root lookup
MPE-NET-056.sentence: When a Store Node validates a back-filled MPE Envelope, the Ledger Adapter shall return the referenced membership root with its period and supersession time if that root was eligible at the MPE Envelope's creation time (visible expiry minus 172,800 s), keeping each root for 172,860 s after the last moment it could authorize an admission, independently of live-tree pruning.
MPE-NET-056.verify: test, a Message admitted late in a membership period under a root published at the period's start and back-filled shortly before its expiry validates; back-fill after two root rotations validates against the historical root.

MPE-PRF-041.title: Bus Node memory ceiling
MPE-PRF-041.sentence: While Reference conditions hold at the sustained Shard capacity, the Bus Node shall keep its resident memory at or below P-PRF-34.
MPE-PRF-041.verify: test, sample resident memory every 10 s through the 72 h soak.

MPE-CON-056.title: Closed outcome set
MPE-CON-056.sentence: The MPE client library shall report every refusal or failure as one of TooLarge, NotReady, NotAccepted, Busy, Refused, ResourceExhausted, StorageExhausted, KeyLimit, Degraded, SourceFailed, Unresolved, RetentionGap, KeyGap, CorruptRecord, LedgerUnavailable, LedgerPaused, BusPaused, InsufficientDust or SessionUpdateRequired.
MPE-CON-056.verify: inspection of the API; fault injection maps each injected fault to exactly one outcome.

MPE-CON-057.title: Carrier attribute
MPE-CON-057.sentence: The MPE client library shall mark every delivered Message with exactly one carrier attribute: `overlay`, `gateway` or `ledger`.
MPE-CON-057.verify: test, deliver one Message over each carrier and check its attribute.

MPE-PUB-053.title: Retransmission stops at admission window end
MPE-PUB-053.sentence: If an unaccepted MPE Envelope's admission window ended more than P-ECO-6 earlier, then the MPE client library shall stop retransmitting it and report `NotAccepted`.
MPE-PUB-053.verify: test, with all Bus Nodes blackholed across an admission window boundary, retries stop P-ECO-6 after the admission window ends.

MPE-PRV-038.title: Anchor count leakage
MPE-PRV-038.sentence: The MPE shall include the per-Shard MPE Envelope counts published in Anchors in the L-L leakage declaration.
MPE-PRV-038.verify: inspection, L-L names the count fields and their window granularity.

MPE-OPS-055.title: Mock Bus Operator roster
MPE-OPS-055.sentence: The Prototype shall register its local Bus Nodes and Store Nodes in the mock Bus Registry relay list under at least P-STO-5 distinct Bus Operator organization identifiers.
MPE-OPS-055.verify: inspection of the fixture; test, the `stored` attribute and reconciliation run on it.

MPE-VER-041.title: End-to-end Prototype scenario
MPE-VER-041.sentence: The Prototype shall demonstrate, in one scripted run against the mock Ledger Adapter, membership registration, publication, overlay delivery, local recognition, a client crash with back-fill resume, Anchor-based `final` labelling and one mock contract reaction.
MPE-VER-041.verify: demonstration, the run log shows each stage with Envelope and logical identifiers and the final contract state.

MPE-FMT-054.title: Carried-event schema
MPE-FMT-054.sentence: The MPE client library shall reserve one schema identifier for carried events, whose payload holds a contract event, the hash of the transaction that recorded it and its position within that transaction.
MPE-FMT-054.verify: inspection of the schema table; test vectors encode and decode a carried public event with its transaction hash and position.

MPE-FMT-055.title: Carried-event bytes unchanged
MPE-FMT-055.sentence: When sealing a carried event, the MPE client library shall place the contract event's `VersionedLogItem` bytes in the payload exactly as the transaction records them.
MPE-FMT-055.verify: test: for events captured during local circuit execution, the carried bytes equal the bytes the Indexer later serves for the same transaction and position; no field is re-typed, re-ordered or truncated.

MPE-FMT-056.title: Carried-event transaction reference
MPE-FMT-056.sentence: The MPE client library shall include in every carried event the hash of the recording transaction and the event's position among that transaction's contract events.
MPE-FMT-056.verify: test: a Consumer locates the event in the finalized transaction from the carried hash and position alone.

MPE-FMT-057.title: Midnight decoder for carried events
MPE-FMT-057.sentence: The MPE client library shall decode a carried event only with the decoder Midnight defines for its `LogEventType` and schema `version`, never with an application payload decoder.
MPE-FMT-057.verify: inspection of decoder dispatch; test: a carried event whose bytes also parse under a registered application schema is decoded only by the Midnight decoder.

MPE-FMT-058.title: Carried `@topic` values sealed
MPE-FMT-058.sentence: Where a carried private event contains `@topic` values, the MPE client library shall carry those values only inside the Sealed Body.
MPE-FMT-058.verify: inspection and test: visible header, Admission Slot and Recognition Tag of a carried private event are independent of its `@topic` values.

MPE-FMT-059.title: Few non-constant emitted bytes
MPE-FMT-059.sentence: The Bus Registry shall emit no more than 72 non-constant payload bytes per Anchor event and 35 per governance event.
MPE-FMT-059.verify: inspection of every `emit` site; analysis: circuit rows per emitted event, since each non-constant emitted byte adds byte-decomposition rows (a 256-byte circuit argument costs 166,241 rows, k = 18).

MPE-CRY-042.title: Published label table
MPE-CRY-042.sentence: MPE shall publish, in the MIP, the complete table of its domain-separation labels and `Misc` event names, in a form ready for registration under the domain-separation registry that MPS-0027 recommends.
MPE-CRY-042.verify: inspection: every label and `Misc` name used by the code appears in the MIP table; hash, MAC, KDF and signature labels have the form `mpe/v1/<purpose>` or are `midnight-pe/id/v1`, and `Misc` names have the form `mip-xxxx:<name>[v1]`.

MPE-CRY-043.title: JubJub Schnorr publisher profile
MPE-CRY-043.sentence: Where the JubJub publisher profile is enabled, the MPE client library shall sign publisher statements with Schnorr signatures over JubJub that Compact's `jubjubSchnorrVerify` accepts.
MPE-CRY-043.verify: test: library signatures verify in a compiled Compact fixture; analysis: rows, proving time and prover-key size of the consumption circuit compared with the Ed25519 profile.

MPE-CRY-044.title: Shielded-key profile deferred
MPE-CRY-044.sentence: MPE shall not freeze a suite identifier for a profile that encrypts to Midnight shielded encryption public keys until the `encrypt_for` construct of MPS-0005 Part 2 is published.
MPE-CRY-044.verify: inspection of the suite table and the MIP: the shielded-key profile is listed as deferred with a reserved, unfrozen suite value.

MPE-CRY-045.title: Shielded-key first-contact profile
MPE-CRY-045.sentence: Where the deferred shielded-key profile is enabled, the MPE client library shall encrypt first-contact Messages to the recipient's Midnight shielded encryption public key, resolved through MIP-0007.
MPE-CRY-045.verify: test on a devnet: a recipient resolved through MIP-0007 opens the Message with its shielded encryption key; the profile is disabled by default (DEC-020).

MPE-CRY-046.title: Circuit-friendly hash preimages
MPE-CRY-046.sentence: MPE shall define every protocol hash that a circuit computes over a struct preimage of fixed-width fields, never over a byte-level concatenation.
MPE-CRY-046.verify: inspection of the hash definitions; test: struct and concatenated preimages give identical SHA-256 digests in the simulator, and the circuit row counts of both forms are reported (12,674 against 133,922 rows for three chained node hashes).

MPE-CON-058.title: Carried event unconfirmed until matched
MPE-CON-058.sentence: The MPE client library shall label a carried event `gossip` until the recording transaction is finalized and its transcript holds the carried bytes at the stated position.
MPE-CON-058.verify: test with the mock Ledger Adapter: a carried event whose bytes differ from the finalized transcript, or whose transaction is not finalized, stays `gossip`.

MPE-CON-059.title: Carried event from a failed fallible phase
MPE-CON-059.sentence: If a carried event was emitted in a fallible segment that did not succeed, then the MPE client library shall never label that carried event `final`.
MPE-CON-059.verify: test on a ledger-9 devnet: a transaction whose fallible segment fails yields a carried event that never becomes `final`.

MPE-CON-060.title: Anchor inclusion bound to the Message
MPE-CON-060.sentence: Where the consumption circuit uses Anchor inclusion to prove publication, it shall prove that the anchored MPE Envelope Identifier commits to a Sealed Body that opens to the signed publisher statement the circuit verifies.
MPE-CON-060.verify: test: a valid signed statement for one Message combined with a valid inclusion path for another Envelope, and a holder of a valid inclusion path who supplies a different Message secret or no publisher signature, each fail to produce an accepted reaction.

MPE-CON-061.title: Coarse expiry disclosure
MPE-CON-061.sentence: The MPE client library's consumption circuit shall disclose, for its expiry check, only a coarse upper time bound chosen by the prover, never the signed expiry.
MPE-CON-061.verify: inspection of the public transcript of a reaction: the only time value is the prover-chosen bound, because every block-time comparison discloses its operand.

MPE-CON-062.title: Deferred `in-block` label
MPE-CON-062.sentence: Where a best-chain Indexer view is enabled, the MPE client library shall label a Message `in-block` while its Anchor or ledger-lane parts sit only in blocks that are not finalized.
MPE-CON-062.verify: test with a mock best-chain view: a Message anchored in an unfinalized block is labelled `in-block`, never `final`.

MPE-CON-063.title: Rollback of `in-block`
MPE-CON-063.sentence: If a reorganization removes the block behind an `in-block` label, then the MPE client library shall withdraw that label and emit a `rolled-back{eid}` notice.
MPE-CON-063.verify: test with a mock reorganization: the label is withdrawn and exactly one notice is emitted.

MPE-ECO-054.title: Admission secret stays with the client
MPE-ECO-054.sentence: The MPE client library shall not send the admission secret, or a witness derived from it, to a prover outside the client's trust boundary unless that prover is attested.
MPE-ECO-054.verify: inspection of the proving path; test: configuring an unattested remote prover fails before any admission witness leaves the client.

MPE-ECO-055.title: Permissionless period pruning
MPE-ECO-055.sentence: When any caller requests removal of a membership tree whose period ended more than P-ECO-5 earlier, the Bus Registry shall remove that tree.
MPE-ECO-055.verify: test on the mock Bus Registry and a devnet: an unprivileged caller prunes an ended period after P-ECO-5; a request before then fails.

MPE-ECO-056.title: Registration price instrument
MPE-ECO-056.sentence: Where a registration price beyond the network fee is enabled, MPE shall state in the MIP the token and receive path of that price, with shielded NIGHT as the default token.
MPE-ECO-056.verify: inspection of the MIP; an unshielded price also applies MPE-ECO-036.

MPE-ECO-057.title: Stable hash for the admission relation
MPE-ECO-057.sentence: MPE shall build the in-circuit admission relation only from hash functions that Midnight documents as stable across upgrades, never from `transientHash`.
MPE-ECO-057.verify: inspection of the relation against the Compact standard library documentation (`persistentHash` is guaranteed to persist between upgrades; `transientHash` is not).

MPE-NET-057.title: Negotiated protocol recorded
MPE-NET-057.sentence: The Bus Node shall record the negotiated GossipSub protocol identifier and internal peer kind of every pubsub connection.
MPE-NET-057.verify: test: connection metrics list the negotiated identifier and peer kind for v1.1, v1.2 and custom-identifier peers.

MPE-NET-058.title: Version policy enforced
MPE-NET-058.sentence: If a peer's negotiated GossipSub protocol is not the selected v1.2 profile identifier, then the Bus Node shall refuse that peer a mesh slot.
MPE-NET-058.verify: negotiation test with a v1.1-only peer and a peer that also offers v1.3: neither joins a mesh under another version; a default offer list is not accepted as proof of v1.2.

MPE-NET-059.title: Local publication checks
MPE-NET-059.sentence: When a local client submits an MPE Envelope for publication, the Bus Node shall apply the same application validation as for a received MPE Envelope before calling GossipSub publish.
MPE-NET-059.verify: test: a locally submitted Envelope that would be Rejected on receipt is never published.

MPE-NET-060.title: Validation within cache lifetime
MPE-NET-060.sentence: If reporting a validation result fails because the message has left the GossipSub message cache, then the Bus Node shall record that MPE Envelope as not propagated.
MPE-NET-060.verify: test: delay validation beyond the message-cache lifetime; the result report fails, the Envelope is counted as not propagated, and no metric reports it as delivered.

MPE-NET-061.title: Publish failure reported
MPE-NET-061.sentence: If the GossipSub publish call fails for an MPE Envelope the Bus Node has accepted, then the Bus Node shall answer the publication request with a single `PublishFailed` reply naming that MPE Envelope Identifier, in place of `Accepted`.
MPE-NET-061.verify: test: with no mesh or fanout peers and with a full publication queue, the client receives `PublishFailed{eid}` as the only reply to its request; with peers and queue space it receives `Accepted{eid}`.

MPE-NET-062.title: IDONTWANT on capable links
MPE-NET-062.sentence: The Bus Node shall send and honour IDONTWANT on every link that negotiated GossipSub v1.2.
MPE-NET-062.verify: test: on v1.2 links IDONTWANT is emitted for messages above the threshold and honoured on receipt; on v1.1 links none is sent.

MPE-NET-063.title: IDONTWANT size predicate
MPE-NET-063.sentence: The Bus Node shall emit IDONTWANT only for messages whose serialized pubsub-message length exceeds P-NET-18 bytes.
MPE-NET-063.verify: test at the boundary: a message of exactly P-NET-18 serialized bytes triggers no IDONTWANT; interoperability reports record each implementation's predicate (Go compares payload length, sends at equality and defaults to 1,024 B).

MPE-NET-064.title: No penalty for sends after IDONTWANT
MPE-NET-064.sentence: If a peer sends a message after the Bus Node's IDONTWANT for it, then the Bus Node shall apply no score penalty for that send.
MPE-NET-064.verify: test: a peer that sends a notified message is not penalised; suppression lifetime and queued-send cancellation are recorded separately from the seen-cache lifetime.

MPE-NET-065.title: IDONTWANT excess limit
MPE-NET-065.sentence: Where an excess-IDONTWANT penalty is configured, the Bus Node shall apply it only above a per-peer, per-heartbeat IDONTWANT limit stated in the release profile.
MPE-NET-065.verify: inspection of the release profile; test: a peer within the stated limit is not penalised, one above it is.

MPE-NET-066.title: Subscription name filter
MPE-NET-066.sentence: If a peer subscribes to a GossipSub topic outside the supported MPE major versions, the selected genesis prefix and the Bus Registry's current or transitional Shards, then the Bus Node shall refuse that subscription.
MPE-NET-066.verify: test: subscriptions with a foreign genesis prefix, an unsupported major version or an unauthorized Shard index are refused; subscription-count limits still apply.

MPE-NET-067.title: No unreviewed GossipSub extensions
MPE-NET-067.sentence: The Bus Node shall negotiate no GossipSub extension that changes message behaviour, including partial messages, unless the release profile specifies and reviews it for privacy.
MPE-NET-067.verify: test: negotiation with a peer offering v1.3 extensions enables none of them; inspection of the release profile.

MPE-NET-068.title: No action on unfinalized state
MPE-NET-068.sentence: The Ledger Adapter shall take no value from a block that is not finalized, whether Bus Registry state, an Anchor, a ledger-lane part or a carried-event transcript.
MPE-NET-068.verify: test with the mock Ledger Adapter: values written in an included but unfinalized block are invisible to every read, so no rollback is needed.

MPE-NET-069.title: Bus Registry clock tolerance
MPE-NET-069.sentence: When a Bus Registry circuit performs a time-dependent write, the Bus Registry shall accept the caller-supplied clock value only within 900 s of the block time.
MPE-NET-069.verify: test on the mock Bus Registry and a devnet: values 901 s from block time fail; a transaction that waits in the pool beyond the tolerance fails.

MPE-NET-070.title: Bus Registry toolchain floor
MPE-NET-070.sentence: The Prototype shall build the Bus Registry, ledger-lane and consumer contracts with a released Compact toolchain at version 0.33.0 or later, which provides `emit` and witness-free cross-contract reads.
MPE-NET-070.verify: inspection: the build log names the toolchain and compiler versions (0.35.0, language 0.27.0 in the reference build).

MPE-PRF-042.title: Circuit sizes stated
MPE-PRF-042.sentence: MPE shall state in the MIP the circuit size, as k and rows, of every Bus Registry, ledger-lane and consumer circuit.
MPE-PRF-042.verify: inspection against `zkir mock-compile` output for each circuit (for example `postAnchor` k = 18, 152,138 rows).

MPE-PRF-043.title: Anchor proving gate
MPE-PRF-043.sentence: If proving one Anchor transaction on the anchorer reference host takes longer than one P-NET-17 window, then the Prototype shall mark Anchor acceptance as failed.
MPE-PRF-043.verify: test: measure proving time and prover memory of the k = 18 Anchor circuit over 100 Anchors on the reference host.

MPE-OPS-056.title: Toolchain and ledger versions named
MPE-OPS-056.sentence: MPE shall state, in each MIP version, the Compact toolchain, language, runtime and ledger versions used to build the Bus Registry, ledger-lane and consumer circuits.
MPE-OPS-056.verify: inspection of the MIP against the build logs.

MPE-PRV-039.title: Per-Message disclosure object
MPE-PRV-039.sentence: When an application discloses one Message to a named reader, the MPE client library shall produce a disclosure object holding the MPE Envelope, its per-Envelope encryption key, the Publisher's verifying key, the Anchor inclusion path and the discloser's signature over the object.
MPE-PRV-039.verify: test: the reader opens exactly the disclosed Envelope, checks the Publisher's signature, recomputes its MPE Envelope Identifier against the Anchor and learns who disclosed it; the key opens no other Envelope of the stream.

MPE-PRV-040.title: Per-period disclosure object
MPE-PRV-040.sentence: When an application discloses one stream for a stated period to a named reader, the MPE client library shall produce a signed disclosure object that opens only that stream's Messages within that period.
MPE-PRV-040.verify: test: Messages of the stream before and after the period, and of other streams, do not open.

MPE-PRV-041.title: Disclosures verified against Anchors
MPE-PRV-041.sentence: When a reader verifies a disclosure object, the MPE client library shall accept a disclosed Message only if its MPE Envelope Identifier verifies under an Anchor in Bus Registry state at a finalized block.
MPE-PRV-041.verify: test: a disclosure object with a forged inclusion path or an unanchored Message is refused.

MPE-PRV-042.title: Disclosure lifetime
MPE-PRV-042.sentence: The MPE client library shall include in every disclosure object an expiry time after which its verification fails.
MPE-PRV-042.verify: test: verification succeeds before and fails after the stated expiry.

MPE-PRV-043.title: Selective-disclosure goals mapped
MPE-PRV-043.sentence: MPE shall publish a mapping of each MPS-0043 selective-disclosure goal, 1 to 5, to a requirement or to an explicit non-claim.
MPE-PRV-043.verify: inspection: every goal has a row; the leakage declaration states that handing over a stream secret is a coarse, irrevocable viewing capability.

MPE-PRV-044.title: Identify leakage declared
MPE-PRV-044.sentence: Where a Bus Node enables the libp2p Identify protocol, MPE shall list Identify's public key, addresses, supported protocols and implementation metadata as permitted leakage.
MPE-PRV-044.verify: inspection of the deployment configuration against the leakage declaration.

MPE-ECO-058.title: Durable credit reservation
MPE-ECO-058.sentence: The MPE client library shall durably reserve each credit (admission window, class, index) before sending any share computed under it, use disjoint credit ranges on devices sharing one membership, and, after a restore with uncertain credit state, not publish under that membership until every admission window it might have used has ended plus P-ECO-6, unless it registers a fresh membership.
MPE-ECO-058.verify: test: crash after reservation and before sending, roll back client state, and run two devices on one membership; in no case do two different MPE Envelope Identifiers carry shares under one admission nullifier.
